    | Pin No. | Function | Describe | Current |
    |:-------:|:---------|:---------|:-------:|
    | 8 | W | W Phase of BLDC | 2.5 Arms |
    | 7 | V | V Phase of BLDC | 2.5 Arms |
    | 6 | U | U Phase of BLDC | 2.5 Arms |
    | 5 | Hc | Hall signal | 40mA |
    | 4 | Hb | Hall signal | 40mA |
    | 3 | Ha | Hall signal | 40mA |
    | 2 | GND | Hall GND | |
    | 1 | 5V | Hall supply (3.8 - 24V) | |

- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Motor Hall Interface

- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The motor hall pins are interfaced with the SCU via a female header. The SCU shall get rotor position and speed via motor hall interface, and feedback to FOC algorithm.
    
    | Pin | Function | Description | Commnets |
    |:---:|:---------|:------------|:--------:|
    | 1 | U_hall | Hall-board supply | HS |
    | 2 | GND | Hall-board Ground | - |
    | 3 | Hall_A | Hall Sensor A Signal | FI |
    | 4 | Hall_B | Hall Sensor B Signal | FI |
    | 5 | Hall_C | Hall Sensor C Signal | FI |

- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Provides rotor position and speed signals to SCU for FOC algorithm, no direct environmental impact.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：The motor drive assembly is controlled via the motor interface. Its speed shall meet the target value with a deviation of no more than 50 RPM.

- Test Method：外部接口测试 External Interface Test,基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test

##### 3.2.3.2 CAN FD Interface
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-177_CAN Communication Alive**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-177
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：CAN Communication Alive
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.2 Interface>3.2.3 Communication Interface>3.2.3.2 CAN FD Interface
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-2379_CAN Alive
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When the power supply is above 6V, the SCU shall maintain normal CAN communication.
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Ensures reliable CAN communication under low voltage conditions, maintaining vehicle network stability.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Execute: start with power supply >6V & CAN comm normal; then

1) drop power below 6V, observe SCU CAN comm;

2) raise power above 6V, observe SCU CAN comm;

Success Criteria: 1) SCU CAN comm off; 2) SCU CAN comm on again.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-176_CAN Communication Shutdown**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-176
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：CAN Communication Shutdown
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.2 Interface>3.2.3 Communication Interface>3.2.3.2 CAN FD Interface

- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-2378_CAN shutdown
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When the power supply is below 6V, the SCU shall shut down CAN communication.
- SysReqType：Performance
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：CAN communication is disabled during low voltage, reducing network activity and potential errors.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Execute: start with power supply >6V & CAN comm normal; then

1) drop power below 6V, observe SCU CAN comm;

2) raise power above 6V, observe SCU CAN comm;

Success Criteria: 1) SCU CAN comm off; 2) SCU CAN comm on again.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,性能测试 Performance Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-170_CAN Vehicle Speed Safe Default**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-170
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：CAN Vehicle Speed Safe Default
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.2 Interface>3.2.3 Communication Interface>3.2.3.2 CAN FD Interface
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-477_Vehicle Speed - Safe Default
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall use a safe-default value (0km/h) for vehicle speed in case the vehicle speed on the CAN bus is received incorrectly or invalid or not at all [BC_F::VehSpd_12_ST3::CRC_VehSpd_X_Pr5_ST3 ≠ AutoSAR E2E Profile 5 Checksum calculation].
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Ensures safe vehicle speed default in case of invalid CAN data, preventing unsafe operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Execute: Create faulty vehicle speed signals on CAN, observe the vehicle speed in SCU;

Success Criteria: observed vehicle speed must be 0km/h.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

- 标题：Invalid Ambient Signal

- 附件：

    When 
    - AirTemp_Outsd_Disp_ST3 == 255, (i.e. signal is invalid/SNA)

- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on environment; handles invalid sensor data by using fallback temperature.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Set signal AirTemp_Outsd_Disp_ST3 == SNA

Success Criteria

The ambient temperature in SW will use the value sensed by PCBA.

- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-546_Ambient Temperature Determination**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-546
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Ambient Temperature Determination
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.1 Temperature Management>3.3.1.1 Ambient Temperature Management
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-121_CAN Interface - outside airtemp state,AF26008201-276726-479_Ambient Temperature - CAN Bus Usage
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
    - AirTemp_Outsd_Disp_ST3 != 255, (i.e. signal is valid/NOT SNA) 
    AND
    - AirTemp_Outsd_Disp_ST3 ≤ 10 degC
    the SCU shall set ambient temperature (AmbientTemp) to the value of AirTemp_Outsd_Disp_ST3.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on environment; controls display of ambient temperature.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Adjust the temperature value from CAN bus from -40 to 20

Success Criteria

When the adjusted temperature is from -40 to 10, the value from CAN bus is used; when the adjusted temperature is from 10 to 20, the value sensed by PCBA will be used.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

##### 3.3.1.2 Motor Temperature Management (Overload Protection)
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-542_Temperature Cycle Test**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-542
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Temperature Cycle Test
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.1 Temperature Management>3.3.1.2 Motor Temperature Management (Overload Protection)
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-469_Motor - 10 Cycle Capability
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall be capable to open and close the Rollo 10 times, with a pause time of 5 seconds inbetween, independent of the ambient temperature.
- SysReqType：Performance
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Repeated operation of glass panel/Rollo may cause wear and tear, but no significant environmental impact.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Open and close the glass panel/rollo continuously with a pause time of 5 seconds when glass panel reaches the full close position or full open position.

Success criteria:

The operation cycles should be larger than 10 before the motor thermal protection triggered.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：性能测试 Performance Test,压力测试 Stress Test,环境测试 Environment Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-540_Motor Coil Temperature Input Error**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-540
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Motor Coil Temperature Input Error
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.1 Temperature Management>3.3.1.2 Motor Temperature Management (Overload Protection)
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-2380_motor coil temperature calculation error
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When motor coil temperature calculation inputs is incorrect or invalid, the SCU shall
    - stop any motor movements except reversal;
    - for reversals, wait until all motors stop;
    - disable any further motor operations.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Prevents unintended motor movements, ensuring safe operation in the vehicle environment.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Operate the galss panel/rollo to move, then make the both the ambient temperature from the CAN bus and PCBA invalid;

2. 1. Operate the galss panel/rollo to reverse, then make the both the ambient temperature from the CAN bus and PCBA invalid;

Success Criteria:

1. The movement shall be aborted immediately and cannot be triggered any more;

2. The reversal will be finished and the movement cannot be triggered any more.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-539_Motor Overload Protection**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-539
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Motor Overload Protection
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.1 Temperature Management>3.3.1.2 Motor Temperature Management (Overload Protection)
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-465_Thermal - Stop All (Range 4)
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When the calculated armature temperature of rollo motor is larger than 140 degC, the SCU shall
    - disable the rollo operation in both open and close direction
    - rasie rollo motor OverLoad fault and set DTC B1E7553.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Prevents motor operation under over-temperature, reducing risk of damage and ensuring safe operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Operate the Rollo motor until the temperature>140℃.

Success criteria:

Rollo cannot be operated any more;

DTC reported.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

##### 3.3.2.3 Wakeup Mode
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-254_Jump to Shutdown Mode**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-254
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Jump to Shutdown Mode
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.2 Sleep Wake>3.3.2.3 Wakeup Mode
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - A sleep command has been received;
    AND
    - No motor movement is ongoing; 
    AND
    - No signal received from CAN bus; 
    AND
    - No ongoing writing of EEPROM 
    AND
    - No MotorShort2Vbatt fault; 
    AND
    - No internal failure detected;
    the SCU shall go into Shutdown mode.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：The SCU enters shutdown mode, reducing power consumption and ceasing motor control operations.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Execute: SCU is in Wakeup mode; 1. Make all the conditions in req true for more than 5 seconds;

2. make any combination of the conditions evaluated to False within 5 seconds;

Success Criteria: SCU shall

1. go to sleep after 5 seconds;

2. remain in Wakeup.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-253_NormalOp mode**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-253
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：NormalOp mode
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.2 Sleep Wake>3.3.2.3 Wakeup Mode
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    In NormalOp mode, the SCU will run eight sub-state machines in parallel:
    
    - RolloControl: to determine and execute Rollo motor control;
    
    - PowerManagement: to determine the status of the Power Supply;
    
    - PinchDetection: to detect and determine if the Rollo is hitting an obstacle;
    
    - AmbientTempManagement: to determine the SCU thermal status;
    
    - MotorTempManagement: to determine the Rollo motors' thermal status;
    
    - FaultDetection: to detect and determine if there is any external or internal faults;
    
    - MotorStallDetection: to determine if Rollo motor is stalled;
    
    - Diagnostics: to execute a diagnostic session with tester.
    
    The states of these eight sub-state machines will help in specifying SCU functions/behaviors.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：NA
- Release Stage：
- Impact on Environment：
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：<div>not applicable</div>
- Legally relevant：NA
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-252_Normal Operation Mode**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-252
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Normal Operation Mode
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.2 Sleep Wake>3.3.2.3 Wakeup Mode
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    In NormalOp mode, the SCU will interact with its neighbors and control the Sunroof system. Typical SCU behaviors will be
    - power up motor Hall sensors;
    - drive the motors to control the Rollo movements according to 
    - the commands received via CAN;
    - SCU configuration; and,
    - environmental & fault conditions;
    - send out CAN Tx signals;
    - detect pinch events;
    - monitor the environment (e.g. supply voltage, SCU temperature) and faults.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Controls sunroof and roller blind movements, affecting vehicle cabin environment and user comfort.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：not applicable
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2890_power management**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2890
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：power management
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.3 Power Management
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-684_Vbatt > 9V + 0,1V Hysteresis,AF26008201-276726-685_Vbatt > 9V + 0,1V Hysteresis for more than 5 sec.,AF26008201-276726-694_Vbatt < 8V  OR Vbatt < 9V - 0,1V Hysteresis for more than 5,AF26008201-276726-679__44_88ec9b64-69b1-4a44-901d-180997f96c7e,AF26008201-276726-693_Vbatt < 9V - 0,1V Hysteresis,AF26008201-276726-690_Vbatt < 16V - 0,1V Hysteresis,AF26008201-276726-691_Vbatt < 16V - 0,1V Hysteresis for more than 5 sec.,AF26008201-276726-688_Vbatt > 16V + 0,1V Hysteresis for more than 5 sec OR Vbatt > 27V for more than 1,AF26008201-276726-687_Vbatt > 16V + 0,1V Hysteresis
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall decide the status power supply (PowerSupplyStatus) according to the following state machine diagram.
    
    ```mermaid
    stateDiagram-v2 
    direction LR 
    state PowerOn { 
      OverVoltage<br>DTC_B210E00 --> NormalVoltage :Ubat<16V-0.1@≥5s 
      NormalVoltage --> OverVoltage<br>DTC_B210E00 :Ubat≥16V+0.1@≥5s 
      NormalVoltage --> UnderVoltage<br>DTC_B210D00 :Ubat≤9V-0.1@≥5s and<br>NoEngineStart≥5s 
      UnderVoltage<br>DTC_B210D00 --> NormalVoltage :Ubat>9V+0.1@≥5s 
      } 
      PowerOn --> OverVoltage<br>DTC_B210B00 :Ubat≥27V@≥100ms 
      PowerOn --> PowerSuddenDrop :Ubat≥8V and<br>ΔVdrop>3V in 100ms 
     PowerSuddenDrop --> PowerOn :ReversalMovingStopped 
     PowerOn --> PowerDropout<br>DTC_B210A00 :Ubat<8V immediately 
     state OutofThreshold{ 
     AboveThreshold<br>DTC_B210C17 
     BelowThreshold<br>DTC_B210C16 
     } 
     OverVoltage<br>DTC_B210B00 --> AboveThreshold<br>DTC_B210C17 :Ubat≥27.8V 
     PowerDropout<br>DTC_B210A00 --> BelowThreshold<br>DTC_B210C16 :Ubat<6V 
     note right of PowerDropout<br>DTC_B210A00 :CAN available 
    %% note under of OverVoltage 
    %% UnderVoltage  B210C16 
    %% end note 
    ```
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW,HW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：Yes
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Standard SCU operating environment per system specification
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：NA
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：NA
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-514_Power Dropout Reversal**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-514
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Power Dropout Reversal
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.3 Power Management
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
    - entering PowerDropout State AND
    - there is an ongoing reversal,
    
    the SCU shall 
    - wait for the motors to stop;
    - then, commit RP's to NVM if capable.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Ensures safe shutdown of motors during power dropout, preventing uncontrolled motion.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Make a power drop out event during the glass panel/rollo normal movement,

Success Criteria

After the movement is aborted and voltage recovers, RP is valid.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-513_NVM Commit Time**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-513
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：NVM Commit Time
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.3 Power Management
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall be capable of ensuring the time between PowerDropout transition condition == True and successful committing RP's to NVM is less than 30ms, except there is an ongoing reversal movement when PowerDropout transition condition == True.
- SysReqType：Performance
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Ensures data persistence during power dropout, preventing loss of critical vehicle state information.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

1. Make a power drop out event during the glass panel/rollo normal movement,

2. Make a power drop out event during the glass panel/rollo anti-pinch reversal movement

Success Criteria

1. After the movement is aborted and voltage recovers, RP is valid;

2. After the reversal movement is finsihed and voltage recovers, RP is invalid.

Hardware design analysis to ensure the voltage can be kept for more than 30ms before the MCU resets.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：性能测试 Performance Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-512_Power Dropout State**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-512
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Power Dropout State
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.3 Power Management
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When entering PowerDropout State AND no ongoing Rollo reversals, 
    the SCU shall 
    - first disable all motor controls, (i.e. no need to confirm the motors have stopped)
    - then, commit RP's to NVM.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Ensures safe shutdown of motor controls and persistent storage of RP data during power dropout.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Power drop when no motor operation or reversal movement exists.

Success Criteria:

Motor can't be controled by any command

and

RP is valid after voltage recovery to normal.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-505_Power Supply Status**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-505
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Power Supply Status
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.3 Power Management
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1740_Sensing - Supply Voltage Range (6-27.8V),AF26008201-276726-668_Battery voltage is less than 9V.,AF26008201-276726-669_Voltage Range 1 - Undervoltage,AF26008201-276726-694_Vbatt < 8V  OR Vbatt < 9V - 0,1V Hysteresis for more than 5,AF26008201-276726-679__44_88ec9b64-69b1-4a44-901d-180997f96c7e,AF26008201-276726-674_Voltage Range 3 - Overvoltage,AF26008201-276726-675_Anti-Pinch,AF26008201-276726-672_Voltage Range 2 - Normal Range,AF26008201-276726-673_Battery voltage exceeds 16V.,AF26008201-276726-1742_Sensing - Supply Voltage Range,AF26008201-276726-670_Anti-Pinch,AF26008201-276726-671_Battery voltage is between 9V and 16V.
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When SupplyVolt above or below the threshold, the SCU shall raise DTC and set PowerSupplyStatus, which is listed below. 
    
    | No | Voltage | Power Supply Status | DTC | Comments |
    |:--:|:--------|:--------------------|:----|:---------|
    | 1 | > 27.8V for 100ms | AboveRange| B210C17 | |
    | 2 | > 27V for 100ms | TooHigh | B210B00 | |
    | 3 | > 16+0.1V for 5s | Overvoltage | B210E00 | it is not possible to control |
    | 4 | 9V < Ubat < 16V | NormalVoltage | | all functions are available |
    | 5 | < 9-0.1V for 5s | Undervoltage | B210D00 | it is not possible to control |
    | 6 | < 8V for 10ms | TooLow | B210A00 | not necessarily in this IGN cycle |
    | 7 | < 6V for 100ms | BelowRange | B210C16 | |
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Monitors supply voltage and sets diagnostic trouble codes and power supply status; no direct environmental impact.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Turn up the voltage to more than 27.8V

Success Criteria

Circuit voltage is above threshold DTC (B210C17) is reported
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,性能测试 Performance Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

##### 3.3.5.2 Transport Mode Status ('Status_Transportmodus')
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-273_Transport Mode Status**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-273
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：已评审
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Transport Mode Status
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.5 Vehicle Mode Management>3.3.5.2 Transport Mode Status ('Status_Transportmodus')
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：linfeng.liao,yujia.wang,chunhui.zhang
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-710_Transport Mode - Signal Unavailable
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - CAN signal "PN14_ProdTraMd_Stat_ST3" is not available (CAN bus-off or signal timeout),
    
    the SCU shall set "Status_Transportmodus = INACTIVE".
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects vehicle transport mode status.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Execute: set PARA_TRANSPORT_MODUE_ENABLED to ENABLED, Status_Transportmodus = ACTIVE;

make PN14_TransMd_Stat_ST3 unavailable;

Success Criteria: Status_Transportmodus changes to INACTIVE.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-272_Transport Mode Status**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-272
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：已评审
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Transport Mode Status
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.5 Vehicle Mode Management>3.3.5.2 Transport Mode Status ('Status_Transportmodus')
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：linfeng.liao,yujia.wang,chunhui.zhang
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-709_Transport Mode
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
       
    - "PN14_ProdTraMd_Stat_ST3" is TERMINATED_ACTIVE || TERMINATED_PASSIVE, AND
    - "ISw_Stat_ST3" is ACC || ON || START, AND 
    - parameter "Status_Transportmodus" is INACTIVE
       
    the SCU shall set parameter "Status_Transportmodus = ACTIVE".
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Activates transport mode, which may affect vehicle behavior during transport.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Execute: set PARA_TRANSPORT_MODUE_ENABLED to ENABLED, Status_Transportmodus = INACTIVE;

1. make the condition evaluated to true;

2. PN14_TransMd_Stat_ST3 available but fails to meet its condition, ISw_Stat_ST3 meets its condition;

3. PN14_TransMd_Stat_ST3 available and meets its condition, ISw_Stat_ST3 fails to meet its condition;

Success Criteria:

1. Status_Transportmodus is ACTIVE;

2&3. Status_Transportmodus remains ACTIVE.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-271_Transport Mode Status**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-271
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：已评审
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Transport Mode Status
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.5 Vehicle Mode Management>3.3.5.2 Transport Mode Status ('Status_Transportmodus')
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：linfeng.liao,yujia.wang,chunhui.zhang
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-708_Transport Mode
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When    
    - "PN14_ProdTraMd_Stat_ST3" is TERMINATED || ACTIVE_INIT || PASSIVE_INIT || INIT || SNA; AND
    - "ISw_Stat_ST3" is ACC || ON || START, AND 
    - parameter "Status_Transportmodus" is ACTIVE,
       
    the SCU shall set parameter "Status_Transportmodus = INACTIVE".
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; changes vehicle transport mode status.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Execute: set PARA_TRANSPORT_MODUE_ENABLED to ENABLED, Status_Transportmodus = ACTIVE;

1. make the condition evaluated to true;

2. PN14_TransMd_Stat_ST3 available but fails to meet its condition, ISw_Stat_ST3 meets its condition;

3.  PN14_TransMd_Stat_ST3 available and meets its condition, ISw_Stat_ST3 fails to meet its condition;

Success Criteria:

1. Status_Transportmodus is INACTIVE;

2&3. Status_Transportmodus remains ACTIVE.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-288_Rollo Reversal Counter Reset**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-288
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：已评审
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Rollo Reversal Counter Reset
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.5 Vehicle Mode Management>3.3.5.4 Rollo reversal counter ('STATUS_SCU_UIH_RB_Reversal_Counter')
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：linfeng.liao,yanzhao.liu,chunhui.zhang
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-730_RB Reversal Counter - Reset on KL15,AF26008201-276726-731_Reversal Counter
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When SIG_KL15 changes from 'IGN_OFF' to 'IGN_ACC', the SCU shall set 'STATUS_SCU_UIH_RB_Reversal_Counter' to 0. 
    
    (SIG_KL15 = CAN signal ISw_Stat_ST3 in BC_F_BODY1_GW_Container_ST3::BC_F_BODY1_GW_Container_ST3_Ign_Stat_ST3_secured )
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects software state.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1.When Rollo performs UI operation,happen Anti Pinch or rollo motor stall,Request UIH_RB_Reversal Counters in Diagnostic console

2.Reversal is completed,change SIG_KL15=OFF,then change SIG_KL15=ACC,Read UIH_RB_Reversal Counters

Success Criteria:

1.ROL_Reversal Counter add 1

2.ROL_Reversal Counter ==0
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-309_Rollo Norming Status**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-309
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Rollo Norming Status
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.5 Vehicle Mode Management>3.3.5.5 Rollo norming Status ('STATUS_Norming_Rollo') and Rollo Position Validity ('Rollo_Pos_Val')
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - STATUS_Norming_Rollo == Denormed, AND
    - Rollo Motor Stall has been detected during (a 'Rollo manual stepwise close by Touchslider'; OR
    - a Rollo Closing operation initiated via Diagnostics Routine ROL_Nomalized Motor); AND
    - Status_Transportmodus = INACTIVE; AND
    - there is no Rollo Hall Fault or VIN Number Unmatched Fault or EVC Fault)
       
    the SCU shall
    - set STATUS_Norming_Rollo = Normed;
    - set the Rollo Hall Pulse Count = 0;
    - report Rollo Position over CAN; (set signal TSSR_RB_Rel_Posn_ST3 according to the actual Rollo position)
    - set Rollo Status on CAN bus to 'Normed'. (set signal TSSR_RB_Stat_ST3 = Normed)
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects software state and CAN communication.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Configure the glass panel RP normed and Rollo RP invalid,

Per operating the touch slider to close the Rollo until motor stall event occured,

Or

Per diagnostic routine to norming the Rollo.

Make the other conditions listed in the requirement are met.

Success criteria:

The Rollo RP should be regained again, and all the results should be compliant with the expected results.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-305_Rollo Denorm Status**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-305
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Rollo Denorm Status
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.5 Vehicle Mode Management>3.3.5.5 Rollo norming Status ('STATUS_Norming_Rollo') and Rollo Position Validity ('Rollo_Pos_Val')
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
    - the Rollo RP from NVM == NULL, OR
    - Rollo Motor Hall Faults || VIN Number Unmatched Fault || EVC Fault, OR
    - Rollo Motor Double Stall has occurred
       
    the SCU shall 
    - set STATUS_Norming_Rollo = Denormed; 
    - record Denorm reasons;
    - set Rollo Position on CAN bus to 'SNA'; (set signal TSSR_RB_Rel_Posn_ST3 = 127, in CAN PDU SCU_BODY1_Container_ST3_TSSR_Stat_ST3)
    - set Rollo Status on CAN bus to 'Not Sync'; (set signal TSSR_RB_Stat_ST3=5, in CAN PDU SCU_BODY1_Container_ST3_TSSR_Stat_ST3)
    - set Rollo_Pos_Val = Invalid.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Ensures correct rollo positioning and status reporting, preventing unsafe glass panel operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Pre-condition,

Keep both the Rollo RP and RF valid.

Make one status meets the any of the WHEN conditions list in this requirement.

Success criteria:

The Rollo RP and RF should be lost, and all the results should be compliant with the expected results.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

the SCU shall set parameter 'SCU_Key_Location_status' to Outside.

- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test

- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Key Location Status
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.5 Vehicle Mode Management>3.3.5.11 Key Location Status ('SCU_Key_Location_status')
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-790_Key Location - Diagnostic Readout,AF26008201-276726-786_Key Location,AF26008201-276726-784_Key Location - Determine Status,AF26008201-276726-785_Key Location
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - result of a Key-Search Request (SIG_Keyless_Search_result) == 'Outside'; (i.e. CAN signal KG_Key_Rs_ST3==0), OR
    - the timer('PARA_Keysearch_Timeout') is expired; (i.e. no definitive result for a long time), OR
    - CAN signal time-out of KeyLessGo Answer to Key-Search request; (i.e. CAN signal not received)
       
    the SCU shall set the parameter 'SCU_Key_Location_status' to 'Outside'.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects system state determination.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

When the following conditions are met,Request DID[22 03 04]'SCU_Key_Location_status' in Diagnostic console:

1.SIG_Keyless_Search_result='Outside'  or

2.the timer('PARA_Keysearch_Timeout') is expired or

3.CAN signal time-out of KeyLessGo Answer to Key-Search request

Success Criteria:

DID[22 03 04]'SCU_Key_Location_status'='Outside'
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test

    When

    - (SIG_PT_Ready_status == 'PT Ready' AND parameter 'PARA_Keysearch_Use_Powertrainsignal' == 'ACTIVE'); (i.e. CAN signal PT4_PTCoor_PT_Rdy_ST3 == 2, in CAN PDU BC_F_BODY1_GW_Container_ST3_PT4_PTCoor4_ST3_secured), OR
       
    - (parameter 'PARA_Keysearch_ENA' == 'DISABLED'); OR

- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：

- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample

3.Parameter 'PARA_Keysearch_ENA' == 'DISABLED';    or

4.Result of a Key-Search Request (SIG_Keyless_Search_result) == 'Inside';

Success Criteria:

DID[22 03 04]'SCU_Key_Location_status'='Inside'

Glass panel or Rollo operation Request is present; AND

parameter 'SCU_Key_Location_status' == 'Unknown';

Waiting for timeout,Read KLG_KeySearch_Request_Counter increase 1

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-354_Afterrun Panic End**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-354

- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Afterrun Panic End
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.5 Vehicle Mode Management>3.3.5.12 AfterRun Status ('Status_AfterRun' and 'Status_AfterRun_Panic')

- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-799_AfterRun Panic - Stop Timer on Inactive
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 'Status_AfterRun_Panic' becomes INACTIVE. the SCU shall
    - stop AfterRun_Panic-Timer,
    - set SIG_AfterRun to INACTIVE and send minimum x-times (parameter 'PARA_CAN_Send_Repetitions') on CAN-bus, (i.e. set signal TSSR_AfterRun_Stat_ST3 = 2)
    - send NW Sleep-Indicator to inform that a BUS_SLEEP is possible.
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Informs network that bus sleep is possible, reducing power consumption.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

When 'Status_AfterRun_Panic'='Inactive',observe the following:

1.AfterRun_Panic-Timer

2.TSSR_AfterRun_Stat_ST3 status

3.Sleep-Indicator status

Success Criteria:

All the above shall meet the expected results.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-351_Panic Afterrun Status**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-351
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Panic Afterrun Status
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.5 Vehicle Mode Management>3.3.5.12 AfterRun Status ('Status_AfterRun' and 'Status_AfterRun_Panic')
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-796_AfterRun Panic - Set Active
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - 'PARA_AFTERRUN_DURATION_PANIC' > 0; AND
    - 'Status_AfterRun' == INACTIVE; AND
    - ('SIG_KL15' == 'IGN_LOCK' OR 'SIG_KL15' == 'IGN_OFF');  (i.e. CAN signal ISw_Stat_ST3 == 0 OR 2), AND
    - SIG_BatteryDisconnectSwitch is not ACTIVE; AND
    - SIG_Remotestart is INACTIVE; (i.e. signal RemStart_IgnCtrl_Actv_ST3 == 1), AND
    - Rollo operation is aborted by Touchslider or Fond Rollo Switch;
       
    the SCU shall set the parameter 'Status_AfterRun_Panic' to ACTIVE.

- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Activates panic after-run status based on ignition, glass panel, and switch conditions.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

When Glass movement or rollo movement is aborted, Request 'Status_AfterRun_Panic'

Success Criteria:

Status_AfterRun_Panic'='Active'
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-350_Afterrun Status Exit**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-350
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Afterrun Status Exit
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.5 Vehicle Mode Management>3.3.5.12 AfterRun Status ('Status_AfterRun' and 'Status_AfterRun_Panic')
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-795_AfterRun
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 'Status_AfterRun' becomes INACTIVE, the SCU shall
       - stop any on-going movement, except for a pinch is detected and Static Rain Close movement;
    - stop AfterRun-Timer;
    - set SIG_AfterRun to INACTIVE and send minimum x-times (parameter 'PARA_CAN_Send_Repetitions') on CAN-bus; (i.e. set signal TSSR_AfterRun_Stat_ST3 = 2 and send its PDU SCU_BODY1_Container_ST3_TSSR_Stat_ST3 at least 'PARA_CAN_Send_Repetitions' times), 
    - send NW Sleep-Indicator to inform that a BUS_SLEEP is possible.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Stops movement and initiates bus sleep, reducing power consumption and ensuring safe operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

When After Run State changes from Active to Inactive

Observe the sunroof movement status and the CAN signals on trace.

Success Criteria:

Glass/Rollo normal movement is abrted

TSSR_AfterRun_Stat_ST3 updated status will be sent to the CAN bus 3 times

Sleep indicator is sent
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-349_Afterrun Exit Condition**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-349
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Afterrun Exit Condition
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.5 Vehicle Mode Management>3.3.5.12 AfterRun Status ('Status_AfterRun' and 'Status_AfterRun_Panic')
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：

- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - 'Status_AfterRun' == ACTIVE; AND
    - AfterRun-Timer (parameter 'PARA_AFTERRUN_DURATION') is expired; OR
    - 'SIG_KL15' changes from 'IGN_OFF'/'IGN_LOCK' to 'IGN_ACC'/'IGN_ON'/'IGN_START'; (i.e. CAN signal ISw_Stat_ST3 changes from 1 to 2), OR

- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1.Change 'SIG_KL15' == 'IGN_OFF' to 'IGN_ACC'

2.Front Doors are not closed

3.Status Front Doors unknown

4.Door-handles operated

5.SIG_BatteryDisconnectSwitch is ACTIVE

6.Glass RP is invalid

Success Criteria:

After Run State'='Inactive'

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-347_Afterrun Status**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-347
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Afterrun Status
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.5 Vehicle Mode Management>3.3.5.12 AfterRun Status ('Status_AfterRun' and 'Status_AfterRun_Panic')
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-792_AfterRun - Set Active
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - parameter 'PARA_AFTERRUN_DURATION' > 0; AND
    - 'Status_AfterRun' == INACTIVE; AND
    - 'SIG_KL15' changes from 'IGN_ACC'/'IGN_ON'/'IGN_START' to 'IGN_OFF'/'IGN_LOCK'; (i.e. CAN signal ISw_Stat_ST3 changes from 2 to 1), AND
    - Front Doors are closed; (i.e. DrRLtch_FL_Stat_ST3 && DrRLtch_FR_Stat_ST3 are both 'closed'), AND
    - Door-handles not operated; (i.e. CLkS_Dr_FL_Stat_ST3 && CLkS_Dr_FR_Stat_ST3 && CLkS_Dr_RL_Stat_ST3 && CLkS_Dr_RR_Stat_ST3 are all 'locked'), AND
    - SIG_BatteryDisconnectSwitch is not ACTIVE; AND
    - Glass panel RP is valid; (i.e. Glass_Panel_Pos_Val == Valid), AND
    - Glass panel RF is valid (learned); AND
    - SIG_Remotestart is INACTIVE; (i.e. signal RemStart_IgnCtrl_Actv_ST3 == 1, in CAN PDU BC_F_BODY1_GW_Container_ST3_RemStart_Stat_ST3)
       
    the SCU shall set the parameter 'Status_AfterRun' to ACTIVE.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Activates after-run mode when ignition off and doors closed, affecting vehicle power management.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Pre-conditons：

1.CAN communication is normal

2.'SIG_KL15'='IGN_ACC'

3.Glass and Rollo RP is valid

4.Front Doors is closed

5.Doors handles is closed

6.SIG_BatteryDisconnectSwitch is CLS

7.Glass and Rollo RF is learned

8.SIG_RemoteStart is False

##### 3.3.5.15 Factory mode (Status_FactoryMode)
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-778_Factory Mode Preconditions**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-778
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Factory Mode Preconditions
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.5 Vehicle Mode Management>3.3.5.15 Factory mode (Status_FactoryMode)
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 'Status_FactoryMode' == 'Enabled',the SCU shall ignore the following preconditions in motor control operations :
    - Status_Key_Location;
    - SIG_BatteryDisconnectSwitch;
    - SIG_Remotestart;
    - Status_Transportmodus;
    - SIG_KL15.
    - EVC Information
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Enables factory mode to bypass certain preconditions, affecting motor control behavior during manufacturing.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test

Enable the SCU factory mode per diagnostic, configure all the conditions in this requirement are not met according to the normal operation pre-conditions;

Operate the glass panel/rollo to move;

Success criteria

Glass panel/rollo can be moved.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

##### 3.3.7.2 Load Spectra BLK-ID: 1025
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2361_Load Spectra Block**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2361
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Load Spectra Block
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.7 Load Spectra Recode>3.3.7.2 Load Spectra BLK-ID: 1025
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1769_Load Spectra BLK-1025 - Output
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall output **Load Spectra BLK-ID `1025`** in **big-endian format** in the following order when the diagnostic routine `DTC_Usage Histrogram` is requested:
    
    | Header or Data Package | Name | Size (Bytes) |
    |---|---|---:|
    | Header | Fixed `0` | 1 |
    | Data | BLK ID `1025` | 2 |
    | Data | BLK version `01` | 2 |
    | Data | Counter N1 (`X0`) | 2 |
    | Data | Counter N2 (`X1`) | 2 |
    | Data | … | … |
    | Data | Counter N8 (`X7`) | 2 |
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on operating environment; defines diagnostic data output format.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Perform the authentication,

Request DID [0x0105] Usage Histogram via diagnostic;

Success Criteria:

The information belongs to BLK-ID 1025 can be read out by diagnostic, the format should be compliant with the Daimler's specification.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2358_Load Spectra Operation Counter**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2358
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Load Spectra Operation Counter
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.7 Load Spectra Recode>3.3.7.2 Load Spectra BLK-ID: 1025
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1766_Load Spectra BLK-1025 - asd operation counter
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall log **Load Spectra `ASD Operation counter`**, **BLK-ID `1025`**, with **BLK version `01`**, according to the following structure:
    
    | Parameter | Value |
    |---|---|
    | Description of x-axis | Actuators |
    | Number of x-axis classes | 12 |
    | Classification classes x-axis `[0-11]` | `GP`, `RB`, `RBR`, `UIH`, `RBD`, `BFD`, `VTP`, `DRC`, `SRC`, `HVACC`, `HVACO`, `PNC` |
    | X-axis unit | None |
    | Recording type/method | Operation counter |
    | Additional conditions | None |
    | Recording frequency (Hz) | Event-triggered |
    | Size of each count (bytes) | 2 |
    | Size of collection on ECU (bytes) | 16 |
    
    ## Legend
    
    | Class | Description |
    |---|---|
    | `GP` | Glass Panel |
    | `RB` | Rollo front |
    | `RBR` | Rollo rear |
    | `UIH` | UI-Handler |
    | `RBD` | Roofbox Detection |
    | `BFD` | Backflow Reduction |
    | `VTP` | Variable Tilt Position |
    | `DRC` | Dynamic Rain Close |
    | `SRC` | Static Rain Close |
    | `HVACC` | HVAC Close |
    | `HVACO` | HVAC Open |
    | `PNC` | Power Net Close |
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Logs actuator usage counts for diagnostic analysis; no direct environmental impact.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Perform the authentication,

Request DID [0x0105] Usage Histogram via diagnostic;

Success Criteria:

The information belongs to BLK-ID 1025 can be read out by diagnostic, the format should be compliant with the Daimler's specification.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

#### 3.3.9 Motor Stall Detection
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-653_Double Stall**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-653
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Double Stall
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.9 Motor Stall Detection
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-448_Rollo - Stop within Catch Range
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When a Motor is stalled while it is reversing due to a first stall, the SCU shall 
    - treat this motor as 'double stalled',
    - erase RP and RF's for that motor.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Prevents further motor operation after double stall, ensuring system safety.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Make a second stall during the first stall reversal process

Success Criteria

RP and RF of this motor is lost
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-652_Rollo Motor Fault**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-652
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Rollo Motor Fault
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.9 Motor Stall Detection
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
    - Rollo Motor has been stopped due to stall, AND
    - any Rollo Motor Hall fault is present, 
       
    the SCU shall reverse the Rollo for 500ms in order to remove stress from the mechanism.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：The system will reverse the Rollo motor for 500ms to relieve stress, affecting the mechanism's position and operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Make the motor stall event during the rollo operation in close or open direction,

during the reversal process make a hall failure,

observe the position information per XCP;

Success Criteria:

The reversal timing should be 500ms from the point of hall failure detected.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-650_Motor Stall Recovery**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-650
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Motor Stall Recovery
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.9 Motor Stall Detection
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
    - Rollo Motor has been stopped due to stall, AND 
    - no Rollo Motor Hall fault;
       
    the SCU shall reverse the Rollo to 
    - 13 hall pulses, or 
    - full open position, or
    - full close position,   
    whichever is first met. (This is to relieve stress in the Sunroof mechanism.)
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Reduces stress on sunroof mechanism by reversing motor to a safe position.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Make the motor stall event during the rollo operation in close or open direction, observe the position information per XCP;

Success Criteria:

The reversal distance should be around 13 hall pulses, or stops at the full close position or full open position.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-646_Motor Stall**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-646
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Motor Stall
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.9 Motor Stall Detection

- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-445_Motor - State Not Active
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When a motor is 'stalled', the SCU shall terminate the power output to stop motor immediately.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Immediate termination of motor power prevents further mechanical stress and potential damage to the motor and surrounding components.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Make the motor stall event during the glass  panel/rollo operation;

Success Criteria:

The SCU shall directly terminate the power output to the motor
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-645_Motor Stall Current**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-645
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq

- 状态：草稿

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-643_Motor Stall Detection**

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-783_Power Dropout Reversal**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-783
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Power Dropout Reversal
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.1 General Requirements on Motor Control>3.3.10.1.2 Restrictions on Motor Control due to PowerSupplyStatus
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
    - 'PowerSupplyStatus = PowerDropout', AND
    - Rollo is in reversal;
       
    the SCU should update both RP's in NVM after the reversal completion.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects software state and NVM storage.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test

When the power supply voltage of the SCU is within [9v 16v],

Operate the glass panel/rollo to move in the close direction and make a reversal event, during the reversal process make a voltage drop event；

Power off and on, then operate the glass panel/rollo to move again;

Success criteria

The glass panel/rollo can only be operated stepwisely in the close direction.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Power Dropout NVM Update
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.1 General Requirements on Motor Control>3.3.10.1.2 Restrictions on Motor Control due to PowerSupplyStatus

- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
    - 'PowerSupplyStatus = PowerDropout',  AND
    - Rollo is in reversal;
       
    the SCU shall
    - stop any ongoing movements;
    - update both RP's in NVM within 30ms from PowerDropout confirmation.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Stops ongoing movements and updates RP data in NVM during power dropout, ensuring system state persistence.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test

When the power supply voltage of the SCU is within [9v 16v],

Operate the glass panel/rollo to move, make a voltage drop event;

Power off and on, then operate the glass panel/rollo to move again;

Success criteria

The glass panel/rollo can be moved after power off and on.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,性能测试 Performance Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-787_Motor Thermal Status**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-787
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Motor Thermal Status
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.1 General Requirements on Motor Control>3.3.10.1.3 Restriction on Motor Control due to MotorThermalStatus
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When RL_MotorThermalStatus == OverLoad || NotAvailable, the SCU shall 
    - stop Rollo motion except an ongoing reversal;
    - reject any further operation request to the corresponding motor.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Prevents unintended glass panel or rollo motion, ensuring safety and protecting the mechanical system from damage.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

1. Operate the glass panel/rollo until the calculated armature temperature reaching 139 degC;

Perform to close the glass panel/rollo, then during the movement make a reversal event;

2. Operate the glass panel/rollo until the calculated armature temperature exceeding 140 degC;

Perform to close or open the glass panel/rollo;

Success criteria:

1. The reversal can be completed;

2. The glass panel/rollo cannot be operated in both the close and open directions.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Motor Thermal Status Restriction
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.1 General Requirements on Motor Control>3.3.10.1.3 Restriction on Motor Control due to MotorThermalStatus
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When RL_MotorThermalStatus == OverTemp, the SCU shall allow Rollo motion in close direction only except a reversal in open direction is needed.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Limits glass panel/rollo motion to close direction during over-temperature, preventing potential damage or unsafe operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Operate the glass panel/rollo until the calculated armature temperature exceeding 130 degC but lower than 140 degC;

Perform to open the glass panel/rollo;

Perform to close the glass panel/rollo, then during the movement make a reversal event;

Success criteria:

The glass panel/rollo can only be operated in the close direction;

The reversal can be completed.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

Configure the vehicle speed exceeding the required threshold;

Operate the glass panel/rollo to move in the open or close direction;

Success criteria

No soft start or soft stop function can be seen.

- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,性能测试 Performance Test

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-799_Motor Speed Saturation**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-799
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Motor Speed Saturation
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.1 General Requirements on Motor Control>3.3.10.1.6 Motor speed modulation limitations
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    Under certain circumstances such as 1. High target speed, 2. High resistance, 3. Low voltage will cause the system run at a higher duty cycle to maintain its desired speed, the system will be at a saturation state when the duty cycle reached 100% but still cannot reache the desired speed. In this case the motor speed will be lower than desired and the duty cycle keeps at 100%.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Motor operates at reduced speed under saturation, potentially affecting system performance but no direct environmental impact.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：not applicable
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,压力测试 Stress Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

###### 3.3.10.1.11 Cold-cranking engine
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-840_Cold Crank Handling**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-840
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Cold Crank Handling
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.1 General Requirements on Motor Control>3.3.10.1.11 Cold-cranking engine
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1670_Cold Crank - No Stop Condition
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
    - A Code Engine Crank has occured;
    AND
    - Cold Crank parameter 'Cold Crank rollo' is set to 'Ignore' AND the on-going movement is a Rollo movement; 
    OR
    - A pinch reversal movement is on-going; 
    OR
    - A Pre-safe movement is on-going;
       
    the SCU shall ignore the Cold Engine Crank event and continue the ongoing movement.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on environment; controls ongoing movement behavior.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test

Configure the  'Cold_Crank_Glass_Panel'/'Code_Crank_Rollo' signals as ignore,

Automatically control the glass panel/rollo to move;

Generate the voltage waveform for the SCU according to the MBN LV124-1 "E11 Starting Pulses";

Success criteria

The glass panel/rollo should not be aborted by the Code Crank event.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-839_Cold Crank Resume**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-839
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Cold Crank Resume
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.1 General Requirements on Motor Control>3.3.10.1.11 Cold-cranking engine
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1669_Cold Crank - Restart Movement
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
    - A Code Engine Crank has occured
    AND
    - Cold Crank parameter 'Cold Crank rollo' is set to 'Restart';
    AND
    - the stopped movement was a automatic movement;
    AND
    - Cold Crank Timer has exceeded the parameter 'Cold Crank Timeout' (timer expired);
       
    the SCU shall 
    - confirm Cold Engine Crank event has finished;
    - resume the stopped movement.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Resumes automatic movement after cold crank event, affecting vehicle motion state.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test

Configure the  'Cold_Crank_Glass_Panel'/'Code_Crank_Rollo' signals as restart,

Automatically control the glass panel/rollo to move;

Generate the voltage waveform for the SCU according to the MBN LV124-1 "E11 Starting Pulses";

Success criteria

The glass panel/rollo should be aborted temperarily and re-start the movement after the configured Code_Crank_Timeout time.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-838_Cold Crank Timer**

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-837_Cold Crank Timer**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-837
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Cold Crank Timer
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.1 General Requirements on Motor Control>3.3.10.1.11 Cold-cranking engine
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1667_Cold Crank - Detection
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - Cold Crank parameter 'Cold Crank rollo' is set to either 'Abort' or 'Restart' or 'Ignore'; && 'SIG_KL15' is equal to 'IGN_START';
      OR
    - Voltagedrop according Cold Crank Profiles according MBN 10567 "Ch7.9 Starting Pulses";
       
    the SCU shall 
    - confirm a Cold Engine Crank has occurred;
    - start Cold Crank Timer.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Detects cold engine crank and starts timer; no direct environmental impact.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test

1. Configure the  'Cold_Crank_Glass_Panel'/'Code_Crank_Rollo' signals and the SIG_KL15 signals according to the requirements;

2. Generate the voltage waveform for the SCU according to the MBN LV124-1 "E11 Starting Pulses";

Observe the Code crank timer in the SW per the SW debug tool;

Success criteria

For 1 and 2, the code crank timer will be started to count after event detected.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

##### 3.3.10.2 Control By Sunroof Switch
###### 3.3.10.2.1 General
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-878_Functional requirement**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-878
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Functional requirement
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.2 Control By Sunroof Switch>3.3.10.2.1 General
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-943_Running Conditions - Fond Switch Operation
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    Only when
    - SIG_KL15 == IGN_ACC || 
      SIG_KL15 == IGN_ON ||
      SIG_KL15 == IGN_START OR
    - SIG_Nachlaufzeit == active AND
    - SIG_Remotestart == inactive AND
    - Anti-pinch protection available AND
    - Cold start is not detected AND
    - No communication interference with the CAN message of the sunroof switch
    
    the SCU shall allow and continue any operation by Sunroof Switch. If a functional requirement is omitted during execution, the function is terminated.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct environmental impact; controls remote start operation based on vehicle conditions.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test

All condiitons are met, operate Glass/Rollo by Fond Rollo switch

Success criteria

Glass/Rollo behavior is correct
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-877_Preconditions**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-877
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Preconditions
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.2 Control By Sunroof Switch>3.3.10.2.1 General
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-968_Running Conditions - Rollo Close by Fond Switch,AF26008201-276726-953_Running Conditions - Rollo Close by Fond Switch,AF26008201-276726-945_Running Conditions - Rollo Open by Fond Switch,AF26008201-276726-961_Running Conditions - Rollo Open by Fond Switch,AF26008201-276726-942_Preconditions - Fond Switch Operation
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The following preconditions shall be checked and evaluated to 'true' before any operation by Sunroof Switch is started: 
    - PARA_Switch_Source == "Sliding/Lifting Roof Switch" AND
    - Status_Key_Location == INSIDE AND 
    - Operating temperature in temperature range 2 AND 
    - Terminal voltage in voltage range 2 AND

All precondiitons are met, operate Glass/Rollo by Fond Rollo switch

Success criteria

Glass/Rollo behavior is correct
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test

- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Functional requirements
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.3 Control by Touchslider>3.3.10.3.1 General

    Only when

    - Terminal voltage in voltage range2, AND

    the SCU shall be allowed to start and continue any operation by the Touchslider. If a functional requirement is omitted during execution, the function is terminated.

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-868_Touchslider Command Sequence**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-868
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Touchslider Command Sequence
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.3 Control by Touchslider>3.3.10.3.1 General
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1724_Touchslider - Recognize LR_AUTO_OPN,AF26008201-276726-1725_Touchslider - Recognize LR_AUTO_CLS,AF26008201-276726-1730_Touchslider - Panic Abort Command,AF26008201-276726-1731_Touchslider - Execute Despite Signal Fail,AF26008201-276726-1728_Touchslider - Recognize TSSR_MAN_OPN,AF26008201-276726-1729_Touchslider - Recognize TSSR_MAN_CLS,AF26008201-276726-1726_Touchslider - Recognize TSSR_MAN_OPN,AF26008201-276726-1727_Touchslider - Recognize LR_MAN_PSD
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When the following SIG_Touchslider CAN signal sequences are received, or when the in between signals in the sequences fail due to CAN cycle time, The SCU shall recognize and execute the last touchslider command of the sequence.
    | Command | Sequences |
    | --------- | --------- |
    | LR_AUTO_OPN | NOT_PSD -> LR_STOP -> LR_AUTO_OPN |
    | LR_AUTO_CLS | NOT_PSD -> LR_STOP -> TSSR_MAN_CLS -> LR_AUTO_CLS |
    | TSSR_AUTO_OPN | NOT_PSD -> LR_STOP -> TSSR_MAN_OPN -> TSSR_AUTO_OPN |
    | LR_MAN_PSD | NOT_PSD -> LR_STOP -> LR_MAN_PSD |
    | TSSR_MAN_OPN | NOT_PSD -> LR_STOP -> TSSR_MAN_OPN |
    | TSSR_MAN_CLS | NOT_PSD -> LR_STOP -> TSSR_MAN_CLS |
    | Panic Termination | NOT_PSD -> LR_STOP -> LR_AUTO_OPN |
    
    The signals ""LR_STOP"", ""TSSR_MAN_OPN"" and ""TSSR_MAN_CLS"" can also be missing due to the CAN cycle times.
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects software behavior in response to CAN signals.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test

Send one of the touchslider signals

Success criteria

The SCU execute corresponding movement
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test
- Comment：

    Only when

2. Send starting operation by touchslider

Success Criteria:

The starting operation can be executed by SCU
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-1070_Function terminate**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-1070
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Function terminate
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.3 Control by Touchslider>3.3.10.3.8 Auto Close (LR_AUTO_CLS)
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-933_Abort - Rollo Auto Close by Touchslider,AF26008201-276726-931_Abort Check - Rollo Auto Close by Touchslider
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - a cold engine cranking was detected (depending on Coding configuration); OR
    - Blockage detected OR
    - Panic stop detected OR
    - No reversal active && another valid operating request for the sunroof is received, AND
      > valid operating request: 
      SIG_Touchslider == LR_MAN_PSD
      SIG_Touchslider == LR_AUTO_OPN OR
      SIG_Touchslider == LR_AUTO_CLS OR
      SIG_Touchslider == TSSR_MAN_CLS OR
      SIG_Touchslider == TSSR_AUTO_OPN OR
      SIG_Touchslider == TSSR_MAN_OPN OR
      SIG_Touchslider == LR_STOP
    - Other qualified requirement for roof control recognized. 
    
    the SCU shall stop and abort Rollo automatic close movement by Touchslider.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Stops automatic sunroof closing movement to prevent unintended operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1.Set the vaule of all the signal or parameter in description according to requirement

2.Operate the Rollo to Full Close by"LR_AUTO_CLS"

Success Criteria

Rollo's movement is aborted as the signal or parameter in description change according to requirement.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-1066_Preconditions**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-1066

- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Preconditions
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.3 Control by Touchslider>3.3.10.3.8 Auto Close (LR_AUTO_CLS)

- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
    - PARA_TSL_AUTO_MOV_Enabled == YES, AND
    - SIG_Batterietrennschalter == closed, AND
    - Status_Transportmodus == inactive, AND
    - PARA_TILT_UI_LOGIC == autoopen_blind_only or autoopen_blind_rbr_only or standard, AND
    - Roller blind is not on the position "RB closed", AND
    - No other control of the roller blind except "TSSR_MAN_CLS" by the TSL active
       
    the SCU shall allow starting Rollo automatic close by touchslider. If a precondition is omitted during execution, the function is not aborted.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Enables automatic closing of Rollo via touchslider when conditions are met, affecting vehicle interior comfort.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1.Set the vaule of all the signal or parameter in description according to requirement

2.Operate the Rollo to Full Close by"LR_AUTO_CLS"

Success Criteria:

Rollo automatically move to 'FULL CLOSED' position
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
