###### 3.3.10.4.4 Rollo Manual Open
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-1832_End**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-1832
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：End
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.4 Control by UI Handler>3.3.10.4.4 Rollo Manual Open
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1369_CAN Response - Rollo Manual Open by UI-Handler
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - Control is withdrawn OR
    - Position "RB open" was reached.
    
    the SCU shall 
    - consider the Rollo automatic  open control by UI-handler completed and stop panel movement.
    - send the following response x-times (parameter 'PARA_CAN_Send_Repetitions') on the CAN-bus
    
    | Signal | Signal value |
    | --- | --- |
    | SIG_RB_Act_Client_ID | Actual Client ID |
    | SIG_RB_Act_Rq_ID | MOV_TO_SR_OPEN |
    | SIG_RB_Act_UI_Stat | REQ_SUCCESSFUL |
    
    - then sent the default signals, refer to AF26008201-278970-2918)
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects CAN bus communication and panel movement control.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Set parameter 'PARA_CAN_Send_Repetitions'=3

2. When Rollo has reached 'Full Open' position or Rollo manual open movement is complete by withdrawn UI handler manuakl command, check signal of UI handler on CAN-bus

Success Criteria:

1. The response signal of requirement send 3 times

2. And the signals value are consistant with the description in reuqirement
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-1831_Function terminate**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-1831
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Function terminate
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.4 Control by UI Handler>3.3.10.4.4 Rollo Manual Open
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1372_Abort - Rollo Manual Open by UI-Handler,AF26008201-276726-1373_CAN Response - Aborted Operation,AF26008201-276726-1370_Abort Check - Rollo Manual Open by UI-Handler,AF26008201-276726-1371_Completion - Rollo Manual Open by UI-Handler,AF26008201-276726-1374_CAN Response - SCU Response Repetition
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - Blockage detected OR
    - Panic Break OR
    - Other qualified requirement for roof control was received
    
    the SCU shall 
    - stop and abort the Rollo automatic open control by UI-handler.
    - send the following response x-times (parameter 'PARA_CAN_Send_Repetitions') on the CAN-bus
    
    | Signal | Signal value |
    | --- | --- |
    | SIG_RB_Act_Client_ID | Actual Client ID |
    | SIG_RB_Act_Rq_ID | MOV_TO_SR_OPEN |
    | SIG_RB_Act_UI_Stat | Corresponding Fault Message |
    
    - then sent the default signals, refer to AF26008201-278970-2918)
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Stops sunroof operation to prevent unsafe conditions during engine crank or conflicting requests.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Send a valid operating request during the Rollo manual open movement by UI-Handler

Success Criteria:

Rollo abort current movement
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-1828_State-Based Function Trigger**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-1828
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：State-Based Function Trigger
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.4 Control by UI Handler>3.3.10.4.4 Rollo Manual Open
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1368_Movement - Rollo Manual Open by UI-Handler,AF26008201-276726-1367_Start - Rollo Manual Open by UI-Handler
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - SIG_UI_RB_Dir_Rq == opening AND
    - SIG_UI_RB_Mode_Rq == one AND
    - SIG_UI_Client_ID != 0
    
    the SCU shall 
    - start an Rollo open movement by UI Handler.
    - Update signal interface with subsequent signals as long as the travel request is in progress

###### 3.3.10.4.5 Rollo Manual Close
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-1843_End**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-1843
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：End
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.4 Control by UI Handler>3.3.10.4.5 Rollo Manual Close
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1392_Completion - Rollo Manual Close by UI-Handler
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - Control is withdrawn OR
    - Position "RB open" was reached.
    
    the SCU shall 
    - consider the Rollo automatic  open control by UI-handler completed and stop panel movement.
    - send the following response x-times (parameter 'PARA_CAN_Send_Repetitions') on the CAN-bus
    
    | Signal | Signal value |
    | --- | --- |
    | SIG_RB_Act_Client_ID | Actual Client ID |
    | SIG_RB_Act_Rq_ID | MOV_TO_SR_CLOSED |
    | SIG_RB_Act_UI_Stat | REQ_SUCCESSFUL |
    
    - then sent the default signals, refer to AF26008201-278970-2918)
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Controls rollo panel movement and sends CAN responses; no direct environmental impact.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Set parameter 'PARA_CAN_Send_Repetitions'=3

2. When Rollo has reached 'Full Close' position or Rollo manual close movement is complete by withdrawn UI handler manuakl command, check signal of UI handler on CAN-bus

Success Criteria:

1. The response signal of requirement send 3 times

2. And the signals value are consistant with the description in reuqirement
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-1842_Function terminate**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-1842
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Function terminate
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.4 Control by UI Handler>3.3.10.4.5 Rollo Manual Close
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1394_CAN Response - Aborted Operation,AF26008201-276726-1395_CAN Response - SCU Response Repetition,AF26008201-276726-1393_Abort - Rollo Manual Close by UI-Handler,AF26008201-276726-1391_Abort Check - Rollo Manual Close by UI-Handler
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - Blockage detected OR
    - Entrapment was detected OR
    - Panic Break OR
    - Other qualified requirement for roof control was received
    
    the SCU shall 
    - stop and abort the Rollo automatic open control by UI-handler.
    - send the following response x-times (parameter 'PARA_CAN_Send_Repetitions') on the CAN-bus
    
    | Signal | Signal value |
    | --- | --- |
    | SIG_RB_Act_Client_ID | Actual Client ID |
    | SIG_RB_Act_Rq_ID | MOV_TO_SR_CLOSED |
    | SIG_RB_Act_UI_Stat | Corresponding Fault Message |
    
    - then sent the default signals, refer to AF26008201-278970-2918)
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Stops sunroof movement, preventing unintended operation during abnormal conditions.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Send a valid operating request during the Rollo manual close movement by UI-Handler

Success Criteria:

Rollo abort current movement
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Set the value of all the signal or parameter in description according to requirement

2. Manual close the Rollo by UI-Handler

The SCU drive Rollo manually to the close direction

- Impact on Environment：Deletes stored Rollo position after aborted automatic close, affecting window control state.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Set the value of all the signal or parameter in description according to requirement

2.  'PARA_CC_AktivKomfort_Enabled' == 'GD + RB'

3. 'SIG_CC_TSSR_Direction' == 'close';

AND

'SIG_CC_RB_Mode' == 'auto';

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_Source' == 'ACTV_COMF'

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_GD_Rq' == '1'

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_RB_Rq' == '1'

4. Then read parameter 'PARA_CC_RB_Stored_Position

5. Abort the Rollo motion then read stored position again

Success Criteria:

1. SCU starting a Rollo auto close movement

2. parameter 'PARA_CC_RB_Stored_Position store the Rollo position before start moving
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

- 依赖：

    When

    - Entrapment detected OR
    - SIG_CC_TSSR_Stop == 1 OR
    - Panic stop detected OR
    - Other qualified requirement for roof control was received   
    
    the SCU shall disable and abort Rollo automatic close movement by Active Comfort via Comfort Control.

- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample

- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Change one of functional requirement to False from True during the movement

2. Create a cold crank situation or send another operationg request during movement

3. Make 'SIG_CC_TSSR_Stop' == '1' or panic abort

Success Criteria:

Comfort Control movement shall be aborted when one of above conditions are satisfied.
- Legally relevant：YES

- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - Blockage detected OR
    - Entrapment detected OR
    - Other qualified requirement for roof control was received
    
    the SCU shall stop and abort synchronous Rollo manual close movement by Comfort Control.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Stops and aborts sunroof rollo manual close movement, affecting sunroof operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Change one of functional requirement to False from True during the movement

2. Create a cold crank situation or send another operationg request during movement

3. 'SIG_CC_TSSR_RB_Rq' != '1'

Success Criteria:

Comfort Control movement shall be aborted when one of above conditions are satisfy
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-1893_End**

- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：End
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.5 Control by the Comfort Control system>3.3.10.5.2 Synchronized>3.3.10.5.2.4 Rollo Manual Open

- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1501_Completion - Sync Rollo Manual Open by CC
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When the Rollo has reached the 'FULL_OPEN' position ('RB offen'), the SCU shall consider the synchronous Rollo manual open by Comfort Control completed and stop panel movement.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Stops panel movement when full open position is reached, preventing over-travel.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Set the value of all the signal or parameter in description according to requirement

2. 'SIG_CC_TSSR_Direction' == 'open'

AND

'SIG_CC_RB_Mode' == 'man'

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_GD_Rq' == '1'

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_RB_Rq' == '0'

Success Criteria:

1. Rollo movement stop when Rollo has reached to "FULL open" position

2. Rollo movement stop when SIG_CC_TSSR_RB_Rq change to != 1
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-1309_End**

- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：End
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.5 Control by the Comfort Control system>3.3.10.5.3 Asynchronized>3.3.10.5.3.1 Auto-open RB during "AktivKomfort"

- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1571_Completion - Rollo Auto Open by Active Comfort,AF26008201-276726-1568_Stored Position
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
    - the roller blind is moved to the position stored in the PARA_CC_RB_Stored_Position parameter,
    
    the SCU shall consider 
    - the asynchronous Rollo automatic open movement has been completed and stop panel movement,
    - and the PARA_CC_RB_Stored_Position parameter is marked invalid.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Stops panel movement after automatic open, no adverse environmental impact.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Set the value of all the signal or parameter in description according to requirement

2. 'PARA_CC_AktivKomfort_Enabled' == 'GD + RB'

3. 'SIG_CC_TSSR_Direction' == 'open';

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_Mode' == 'auto';

AND

'SIG_CC_RB_Mode' == 'auto';

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_Source' == 'ACTV_COMF';

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_GD_Rq' == '1';

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_RB_Rq' == '1';

Success Criteria:

1. Rollo movement stop when Rollo has reached to "FULL open" position

2. Rollo movement stop when 'SIG_CC_TSSR_GD_Rq' != '1' or 'SIG_CC_TSSR_RB_Rq' == '1'
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

- 编号：AF26008201-278970-1915
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Functional requirements
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.5 Control by the Comfort Control system>3.3.10.5.3 Asynchronized>3.3.10.5.3.2 Rollo Manual Close
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1575_Running Conditions - Sync Rollo Manual Close by CC
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    Only when
    - PARA_CC_Enabled != NO AND
    - SIG_KL15 == IGN_LOCK AND
    - SIG_Nachlaufzeit == inactive AND
    - SIG_Remotestart == inactive AND
    - SIG_CC_TSSR_Direction == close AND
    - SIG_CC_RB_Mode == one AND
    - SIG_CC_TSSR_Mode == man AND
    - SIG_CC_TSSR_Source == CC AND
    
    the SCU shall allow starting and continuing asynchronous Rollo manual close via Comfort Control operation.
    and If a functional requirement is omitted during execution, the function shall be terminated.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Enables manual close of Rollo via Comfort Control under specified conditions, affecting vehicle comfort system operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Change any one of condition in functional requirement so that it does not meet the requirement during or before the movment

Success Criteria:

1. The movement will be aborted when change any one of condition in functional requirement so that it does not meet the requirement during the movment

2. The movement will be aborted when change any one of condition in functional requirement so that it does not meet the requirement before the movment
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-1927_Rollo Full Open Stop**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-1927
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Rollo Full Open Stop
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.5 Control by the Comfort Control system>3.3.10.5.3 Asynchronized>3.3.10.5.3.3 Rollo manual open
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1587_Completion - Sync Rollo Manual Open by CC
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When the Rollo has reached the 'FULL_OPEN' position ('RB offen'), the SCU shall consider the asynchronous Rollo manual open by Comfort Control completed and stop panel movement.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on environment; controls panel movement.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Set the value of all the signal or parameter in description according to requirement

2. 'SIG_CC_TSSR_Direction' == 'open';

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_Mode' == 'man'

AND

'SIG_CC_RB_Mode' == 'man'

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_GD_Rq' == '1'

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_RB_Rq' == '1'

Success Criteria:

1. Rollo movement stop when Rollo has reached to "FULL open" position

2. Rollo movement stop when 'SIG_CC_TSSR_GD_Rq' != '1' or 'SIG_CC_TSSR_RB_Rq' == '1'
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-1926_Function terminate**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-1926
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Function terminate
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.5 Control by the Comfort Control system>3.3.10.5.3 Asynchronized>3.3.10.5.3.3 Rollo manual open
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1588_Abort - Sync Rollo Manual Open by CC,AF26008201-276726-1586_Abort Check - Sync Rollo Manual Open by CC
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - Blockage detected OR
    - Other qualified requirement for roof control was received
     
    the SCU shall stop and abort an asynchronous Rollo manual open movement by Comfort Control.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Stops and aborts asynchronous Rollo manual open movement under specified conditions, affecting comfort control operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Change one of functional requirement to False from True during the movement

2. Create a cold crank situation or send another operationg request during movement

3. Make 'SIG_CC_TSSR_GD_Rq' != '1' or 'SIG_CC_TSSR_RB_Rq' != '1'

Success Criteria:

Comfort Control movement shall be aborted when one of above conditions are satisfy
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

Success Criteria:

Comfort Control movement shall be aborted when one of above conditions are satisfy

- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.5 Control by the Comfort Control system>3.3.10.5.3 Asynchronized>3.3.10.5.3.5 Rollo Automatic Open
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1596_Abort - Sync Rollo Auto Open by CC,AF26008201-276726-1594_Abort Check - Sync Rollo Auto Open by CC
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - Blockage detected OR
    - SIG_CC_TSSR_Stop == 1 OR
    - Panic stop detected OR
    - Other qualified requirement for roof control was received
    
    the SCU shall stop and abort asynchronous Rollo automatic open movement via Comfort Control.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Stops sunroof movement to prevent unsafe operation during abnormal conditions.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Change one of functional requirement to False from True during the movement

2. Create a cold crank situation or send another operationg request during movement

3. Make 'SIG_CC_TSSR_Stop' == '1' OR a 'panic stop' is send out

Success Criteria:

Comfort Control movement shall be aborted when one of above conditions are satisfy
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Edge-Based Function Trigger
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.5 Control by the Comfort Control system>3.3.10.5.3 Asynchronized>3.3.10.5.3.5 Rollo Automatic Open

- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1592_Start - Sync Rollo Auto Open by CC,AF26008201-276726-1593_Movement - Sync Rollo Auto Open by CC
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - SIG_CC_TSSR_GD_Rq == 1 AND
    - SIG_CC_TSSR_RB_Rq == 1
    
    the SCU shall start asynchronous Rollo automatic open movement via Comfort Control.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Initiates automatic opening of Rollo (shutter) when conditions are met, affecting vehicle interior environment.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Set the value of all the signal or parameter in description according to requirement

2. 'SIG_CC_TSSR_Direction' == 'open';

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_Mode' == 'auto'

AND

'SIG_CC_RB_Mode' == 'auto'

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_GD_Rq' == '1'

AND

'SIG_CC_TSSR_RB_Rq' == '1'

Success Criteria:

SCU starting a Rollo auto open movement
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-1313_Functional Requirements**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-1313
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Functional Requirements
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.5 Control by the Comfort Control system>3.3.10.5.3 Asynchronized>3.3.10.5.3.5 Rollo Automatic Open

- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-1591_Running Conditions - Sync Rollo Auto Open by CC
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    Only when
    - PARA_CC_Enabled == CAR AND
    - SIG_KL15 == IGN_LOCK AND
    - SIG_Nachlaufzeit == inactive AND
    - SIG_Remotestart == inactive AND
    - SIG_CC_TSSR_Direction == open AND
    - SIG_CC_TSSR_Mode == auto AND
    - SIG_CC_RB_Mode == auto AND
    - SIG_CC_TSSR_Source == CC AND
    
    the SCU shall allow starting and continuing asynchronous Rollo automatic open via Comfort Control operation.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Enables automatic Rollo opening via Comfort Control when conditions are met, affecting vehicle comfort operations.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Change any one of condition in functional requirement so that it does not meet the requirement during or before the movment

Success Criteria:

1. The movement will be aborted when change any one of condition in functional requirement so that it does not meet the requirement during the movment

2. The movement will be aborted when change any one of condition in functional requirement so that it does not meet the requirement before the movment
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

##### 3.3.10.6 Auto re-norming function
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-1663_Auto Re-Norming Function**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-1663
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Auto Re-Norming Function
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.6 Auto re-norming function
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The auto re-norming function shall be enabled or disabled by diagnostic.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on operating environment.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Test cases are designed using equivalence class partitioning

Valid equivalence class: Glass/Rollo Auto Renorming Counter Enable is valid

Invalid equivalence class: Glass/Rollo Auto Renorming Counter Enable=No Renorming

When glass runs endurance test, self-learning should be able to update to the new RP correctly

Request Auto Renorming Function under High and Low Voltage

Success Criteria:

When the valid conditions is satisfied: Glass/Rollo move to Full Close position and RP updated

When the invalid conditions is satisfied:  Glass/Rollo move to Full Close position,RP is not updated

Glass RP updated

The Auto Renorming Function does not perform at Low and High Voltage
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

##### 3.3.10.9 Anti-pinch reversal
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2022_Anti-Pinch Reversal Extension**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2022
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Anti-Pinch Reversal Extension
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.9 Anti-pinch reversal
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-524_System Requirement
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall continue a reversal for 500ms (time-based) in case the glass panel/rollo positioning becomes invalid during the reversal.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Ensures continued reversal operation for 500ms when glass panel/rollo position is invalid, maintaining safety during operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Operate the glass panel/roolo in the opening/closing direction and make a reversal event;

At the time of reversal started, make a hall fault for the glass panel/rollo motor;

Success criteria:

The reversal should continue for 500ms after hall fault detected.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,性能测试 Performance Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2021_4mm Rod Detection**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2021

- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：4mm Rod Detection

    When the Glass panel or Rollo is closing, the SCU shall be able to detect a 4mm Rod which is placed freely from the inside to the outside of the sunroof and reverse into open direction.

Success Criteria:

- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2020_Rollo Pinch Reversal**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2020
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Rollo Pinch Reversal
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.9 Anti-pinch reversal
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-491_Anti-Pinch - Reversal on Open (Slide Area)
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When a Rollo Pinch has been detected in Rollo Slide Area during an opening movement, the SCU shall reverse the Rollo blind in close direction for a Rollo distance of 2mm -0mm/+1mm or to Full Close position.
- SysReqType：Performance
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：The rollo blind reverses to close direction, affecting the physical position of the blind in the slide area.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Operate the rollo in the opening direction from full close position and make a reversal event;

Success criteria:

The reversal distance of the rollo should be 2mm.

Note: For the requirement that the reversal limitation is full close position, code design review should be implemented.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,性能测试 Performance Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2017_Rollo Pinch Reversal**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2017
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Rollo Pinch Reversal
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.9 Anti-pinch reversal
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-488_Anti-Pinch - Reversal on Close (Slide Area)
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When a Rollo Pinch has been detected in the Rollo Area during a closing movement, the SCU shall reverse the Rollo blind in open direction till
    - 140mm more open than reversal position, OR
    - limited to full open position.
- SysReqType：Performance
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Controls window blind movement to prevent pinch hazards, ensuring safe operation in vehicle interior.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

1. Operate the rollo in the closing direction from full open position and make a reversal event;

2. Continue the operation until the distance between front leading of the rollo and the vehiche roof edge is less than 140mm;

Operate the rollo in the closing direction and make a reversal event immediately;

Success criteria:

1. The reversal distance of the rollo should be 140mm;

2. The rollo should reverse to the full open position.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,性能测试 Performance Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2011_Anti-Pinch Reversal**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2011
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Anti-Pinch Reversal
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.9 Anti-pinch reversal
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    Anti-pinch reversal shall not be interrupted except the motor stall or power supply dropout.
- SysReqType：Constraint
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Ensures safe operation of power windows by preventing injury during auto-reversal.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Perform Anti-pinch reversal for the glass panel/rollo;

1. Make Motor Stall during the reversal process;

2. Make Power supply dropout during the reversal process;

3. Send new command during the reversal process;

Success Criteria:

1. Reversal process should be aborted;

2. Reversal will be aborted before finished, after power on again, the glass panel/rollo only can be operated stepwisely;

3. Reversal should be continued and finished.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：ATS Threshold Block
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.10 Rollo Motor Control>3.3.10.9 Anti-pinch reversal
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-505_Anti-Pinch - ATS Threshold Blocks
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall have at least four configurable ATS threshold blocks for which the following can be configured:
    - Ambient Temperature Range
    - Voltage Range
    - Vehicle Speed Range
    - Position Area
    - ATS Threshold
    - Rollo
    
    Where ATS Threshold shall be an interpolated value between dx/dy with configurable x and y values.
       
    Info: x could be a predefined value. Interpolating is the ideal situation, but not mandatory.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Configures ATS thresholds based on ambient conditions, no direct environmental impact.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Code design review to ensure the configurable ATS threshold blocks based on configurable ambient temperature range, voltage range, vehicle speed range, position area are correctly implemented.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,性能测试 Performance Test
- Comment：

#### 3.3.11 Pinch Detection Mechanisms
##### 3.3.11.1 General Requirements on Pinch Detection Mechanisms
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-570_Not Learned Pinch Disable**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-570
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Not Learned Pinch Disable
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.11 Pinch Detection Mechanisms>3.3.11.1 General Requirements on Pinch Detection Mechanisms
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When any of the two RF's for the rollo is not learned, 
    the SCU shall disable Pinch Detection function for the Rollo.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Disables pinch detection when RFs not learned, potentially affecting window/rollo operation safety.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

1. Make all the conditions for the glass panel pinch detection met;

2. Make any of the conditions for the glass panel pinch detection not met;

3. Make all the conditions for the rollo pinch detection met;

4. Make any of the conditions for the rollo pinch detection not met;

Success criteria:

1. The pinch detection can be triggered during the glass panel movement;

2. The pinch detection cannot be triggered during the glass panel movement.

3. The pinch detection can be triggered during the rollo movement;

4. The pinch detection cannot be triggered during the rollo movement.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

1. Make all the conditions for the glass panel pinch detection met;

2. Make any of the conditions for the glass panel pinch detection not met;

3. Make all the conditions for the rollo pinch detection met;

4. Make any of the conditions for the rollo pinch detection not met;

Success criteria:

1. The pinch detection can be triggered during the glass panel movement;

2. The pinch detection cannot be triggered during the glass panel movement.

3. The pinch detection can be triggered during the rollo movement;

4. The pinch detection cannot be triggered during the rollo movement.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-567_Pinch Detection N-T Curve**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-567
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Pinch Detection N-T Curve
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.11 Pinch Detection Mechanisms>3.3.11.1 General Requirements on Pinch Detection Mechanisms
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall be able to correctly detect a pinch event over motor variations with slope on N-T curve ranging [8.09 14.85 RPM/Nm].
- SysReqType：Performance
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Detects pinch events to prevent injury or damage during window operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Perform the anti-pinch test using 5, 10, 20 and 65N/mm spring under static situation;

Perform the 4mm rod test under static situation;

Test method must follow the requirements described in chapter '10.4 Calibration and Validation of ATS'.

Use various motors agreed with Inalfa to perform the tests;

Success Critieria:

for all the types of motors,

Test results should be less than 100N;

4mm rod can be successfully detected.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：性能测试 Performance Test,基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

###### 3.3.11.2.2 Static status
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-575_Pinch Force Limit**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-575
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Pinch Force Limit
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.11 Pinch Detection Mechanisms>3.3.11.2 Pinch Force Limits>3.3.11.2.2 Static status
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When vehicle is under static conditions:
    - the actual Vehicle speed below or equal to 5km/h;
    - the actual Voltage Supply range is between 9V and 16V (±0.1V);
    - the actual Ambient Temperature Range is between -20°C and +90°C (±1°C)
       
    the SCU shall be able to detect a Pinch before the Pinch Force reaches 100N.
- SysReqType：Performance
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Ensures safe operation under specified static conditions, preventing pinch hazards.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Perform the anti-pinch force test when the listed conditions are met.

Test method must follow the requirements described in chapter '10.4 Calibration and Validation of ATS'.

Success criteria:

The test results should be lower than 100N.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,性能测试 Performance Test,环境测试 Environment Test
- Comment：

###### 3.3.13.2.2 Standardize Rollo via touchslider
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-446_End**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-446
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：End
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.13 SCU Configuration Data>3.3.13.2 Reference Point (RP)>3.3.13.2.2 Standardize Rollo via touchslider
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-844_Completion - Rollo Manual Stepwise Close by Touchslider,AF26008201-276726-413_Rollo - Reference Point Validity,AF26008201-276726-411_Rollo - Reference Point Learning
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When Blockage detected in the current step
    (reverb pulses for a time greater than PARA_JAM_Detection_Time)
    
    the SCU shall stop drive rollo, and
    - The logical position is set to "RB Block".
    - SIG_RB_Status = "RB closed"
    - SIG_RB_Position is set to 0% for "RB zu".
    - Error code ERR_RB_NO_SYNC is set to the "Saved" status.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on environment; affects sunroof control behavior.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Set the value of all the signal or parameter in description according to requirement

2. Send
 - SIG_Touchslider == LR_MAN_PSD OR
- SIG_Touchslider == LR_AUTO_CLS OR
- SIG_Touchslider == TSSR_MAN_CLS OR
- SIG_Touchslider == LR_AUTO_OPN 

3. reverb pulses for a time greater than PARA_JAM_Detection_Time

Success Criteria:

SCU shall recoard the RB block position.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

- SIG_Touchslider == LR_AUTO_OPN 

Success Criteria:

SCU starting a Rollo manual open movement

- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Functional requirements
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.13 SCU Configuration Data>3.3.13.2 Reference Point (RP)>3.3.13.2.2 Standardize Rollo via touchslider

- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-840_Running Conditions - Rollo Stepwise Close by Touchslider,AF26008201-276726-814_Running Conditions - Touchslider Operation
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The following conditions shall be checked and evaluated throughout any operation by the Touchslider:
    - SIG_KL15 == IGN_ACC OR
    - SIG_KL15 == IGN_ON OR
    - SIG_Remotestart == inactive AND
    - Status_Key_Location == INSIDE AND
    - Terminal voltage in voltage range 2 AND
    - Operating temperature in temperature range 2 AND
    - Blockage detected in the current step
    (No reverb pulses for a time greater than PARA_JAM_Detection_Time)
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on environment; conditions for touchslider operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：not applicable
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2934_End**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2934
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：End
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.13 SCU Configuration Data>3.3.13.2 Reference Point (RP)>3.3.13.2.3 Standardize Rollo via Sunroof switch
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-413_Rollo - Reference Point Validity,AF26008201-276726-411_Rollo - Reference Point Learning,AF26008201-276726-836_Completion - Rollo Manual Stepwise Close by Switch
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When Blockage detected in the current step
    (reverb pulses for a time greater than PARA_JAM_Detection_Time)
    
    the SCU shall stop drive rollo, and
    - The logical position is set to "RB Block".
    - SIG_RB_Status = "RB closed"
    - SIG_RB_Position is set to 0% for "RB zu".
    - Error code ERR_RB_NO_SYNC is set to the "Saved" status.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：NA
- Cyber Security：NA
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Initiates manual rollo movement, affecting window position.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Set the value of all the signal or parameter in description according to requirement

2. Send SIG_Touchslider == LR_MAN_PSD

3. when reverb pulses for a time greater than PARA_JAM_Detection_Time

Success Criteria:

SCU shall recoard the RB block position
- Legally relevant：NA
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

SCU starting a Rollo manual movement

- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2932_Functional Requirements**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2932
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Functional Requirements
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.13 SCU Configuration Data>3.3.13.2 Reference Point (RP)>3.3.13.2.3 Standardize Rollo via Sunroof switch
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-832_Running Conditions - Rollo Stepwise Close by Switch
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The following conditions shall be checked and evaluated throughout any operation by the Touchslider:
    - SIG_KL15 == IGN_ACC OR
    - SIG_KL15 == IGN_ON OR
    - SIG_Remotestart == inactive AND
    - Status_Key_Location == INSIDE AND
    - Terminal voltage in voltage range 2 AND
    - Operating temperature in temperature range 2
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：NA
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on environment; conditions for switch operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Change the RL_MotorThermalStatus != OpTemp during or before the movement

Success Criteria:

1. The movement shall be aborted when change the RL_MotorThermalStatus != OpTemp during the movement

2. The movement shall not start when change the RL_MotorThermalStatus != OpTemp before the movement
- Legally relevant：NA
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2931_Preconditions**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2931
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Preconditions
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.13 SCU Configuration Data>3.3.13.2 Reference Point (RP)>3.3.13.2.3 Standardize Rollo via Sunroof switch

- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-831_Preconditions - Rollo Manual Stepwise Close by Switch
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
    - There is no on-going movement; AND
    - Rollo RP is invalid; AND
    - SIG_BatteryDisconnectSwitch == closed; AND
    - Status_Transportmodus == Inactive; AND
    - The step size is defined by the PARA_RB_NOSYNC_STEP_CLOSE parameter.
    
    the SCU shall allow to dirve the rollo by sunroof switch.  If a precondition is omitted during execution, the function is not aborted.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：NA
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on environment; ensures safe operation of rollo position norming.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

1. Set the value of all the signal or parameter in description according to requirement

2. Send starting operation by switch

Success Criteria:

The starting operation can be executed by SCU
- Legally relevant：NA
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

##### 3.3.13.3 Reference Fields (RF)
###### 3.3.13.3.1 General
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-456_Rollo RF Learn Status**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-456
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Rollo RF Learn Status
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.13 SCU Configuration Data>3.3.13.3 Reference Fields (RF)>3.3.13.3.1 General
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-442_In case the sunroof control detects an error on Hall sensor data (e
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
    - any Rollo RF in EEPROM is NOT set; (getting 0's from EEPROM), OR
    - any Rollo RF's EEPROM is corrupted; (failed to read from EEPROM or getting unmatched checksum), OR
    - STATAUS_Norming_Rollo == Denormed; OR
    - any Hall Fault is present;
       
    the SCU shall 
     - consider Rollo RFs Not Learned;
     - erase Rollo RFs in EEPROM.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects EEPROM data and system state.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

1, Make more than 1 of the 2 Rollo RFs invalid and all the other RFs valid,

2. Configure the STATUS_Norming_Rollo status as Denormed;

3. Fault injection to make Rollo motor hall fault

Success criteria:

The Rollo RF shall be invalid.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-461_Reference Field Storage**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-461
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Reference Field Storage
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.13 SCU Configuration Data>3.3.13.3 Reference Fields (RF)>3.3.13.3.2 RF learning
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When during the learning process 
    - Vehicle Speed is above 5 km/h ; OR
    - Voltage_Range !=11~15V; OR
    - AmbientTemp != 0~45℃;
       
    the SCU shall not be aborted but the new reference fields shall not be stored.
- SysReqType：Constraint
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Prevents storage of reference fields under invalid conditions, ensuring data integrity.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

During the glass panel reference field learning process:

1. Make all the conditions of the requirements are met;

2. Make any of the conditions of the requirement is not met;

Check the operation status of the glass panel after the learning process

Success criteria:

1. Glass panel can be normally operated;

2. Only step wise operation for the glass panel is available.

Make the glass panel RP and RF normal.

During the Rollo reference field learning process:

1. Make all the conditions of the requirements are met;

2. Make any of the conditions of the requirement is not met;

Check the operation status of the Rollo after the learning process.

Success criteria:

1. Rollo can be normally operated;

2. Only step wise operation for the Rollo is available.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-473_Rollo Reference Field Learning**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-473
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Rollo Reference Field Learning
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.13 SCU Configuration Data>3.3.13.3 Reference Fields (RF)>3.3.13.3.3 Standardize rollo via diagnostic
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall execute the following sequencial steps during the reference field learning:
    - Close Rollo to 'Full Close'
    - Unset Rollo Reference Field validity;
    - Open Rollo to 'Full Open' position;
    - Store Rollo Open Reference Field;
    - Close Rollo to 'Full Close' position;
    - Store Rollo Close Reference Field;
    - Set Rollo Reference Field validity to valid;
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on environment; controls roller shutter positions.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Make all the conditions for the Rollo reference field learning are met,

Request the Rollo reference filed learning per diagnostic;

Monitor the reference learning process and check the Rollo reference field validity after the learning process finished.

Success criteria:

The running process should be same as the description and the reference field validity should be valid.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-483_Reference Field Update**

- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Reference Field Update
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.13 SCU Configuration Data>3.3.13.3 Reference Fields (RF)>3.3.13.3.4 Reference field adaptive updating

- 附件：

    When
    - the Rollo has completed a continuous movement from one end to the other without any interruption; AND
    - SupplyVolt is between 11.0 volts and 15.0 volts during the entire travel; AND
    - Vehicle speed is less than 5 Km/h; AND
    - There is no voltage fluctuation event detected; AND
    - AmbientTemp is available and within the range of 0℃ to 45℃;AND
    - Motor coil temperature is available and within the range of [-40~130] °C

    - commit the RF(s) to NVM;
    - update the corresponding RF(s) immediately so that it will take effect in the next operation.

- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,性能测试 Performance Test,环境测试 Environment Test

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-497_VIN Change Prevention**

Sending the default VIN number (17 bytes of 0x41h )on the CAN bus;

Read out the 'PARA_SCU_VINcurrent' vaule per diagnostic from NVM;

Success Criteria:

The 'PARA_SCU_VINcurrent' should not be the default VIN value.

- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-493_VIN Validity Check**

- Sources：External
- Rationale：

- ASIL Level：QM

- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects data validity in vehicle network.
- Verification Method：测试Test

- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2026_Diagnostic Command Start Condition**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2026
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Diagnostic Command Start Condition
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.1 未分组
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    Only when There is no on-going panel movement except norming or learning operations; AND 'SIG_BatteryDisconnectSwitch' == 'closed'; AND Status_Key_Location == 'INSIDE'; AND 'Status_Transportmodus' == 'Inactive'; the SCU shall allow starting any operation by Diagnostic Command.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; controls diagnostic operations in vehicle.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Request a glass panel/rollo movment per diagnostic;

1. when all the conditions are met;

2. when any of the conditions is not met;

Success Criteria:

1. The glass panel/rollo movement can be triggered;

2. The glass panel/rollo movement cannot be triggered, or the movement is aborted.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

- Anti pinch seal input

Success Criteria

Reply positive response and behavior is correctly presented.

- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test

###### 3.3.14.1.4.3.2 User Authentication
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2084_Authenticated State**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2084
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Authenticated State
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.3 Secure diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.3.2 User Authentication

- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    An Authenticated State is always linked to a certain Diagnostic Channel (i.e. a certain Diagnostic Test Tool with its SourceAddress). All authentication settings (DiagnosticUserRole, ?) are valid only for the respective Diagnostic Channel between the Diagnostic Test Tool and one or more ECUs. It is not possible to communicate with another Diagnostic Test Tool using the same Diagnostic Channel. Parallel Authenticated States are supported by the Standard Security Architecture, but only on different Diagnostic Channels.

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2083_Diagnostic Authentication States and Transitions**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2083
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Diagnostic Authentication States and Transitions
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.3 Secure diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.3.2 User Authentication
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    ## States
    
    | State | Description |
    |---|---|
    | A – Unauthenticated State | No access to restricted diagnostic functionalities. |
    | B – Authenticated State | Access to restricted diagnostic functionalities, as defined for the corresponding `DiagnosticUserRole`. |
    
    ## Transitions
    
    | ID | Transition | Trigger |
    |---|---|---|
    | 1 | ECU / Application start-up | The ECU or application starts up. |
    | 2 | Stay in an Unauthenticated State | Unsuccessful user authentication. |
    | 3 | Enter an Authenticated State | Successful user authentication, or valid authentication broadcast received. |
    | 4 | Stay in an Authenticated State | Valid diagnostic request, valid authentication broadcast received, unsuccessful attempt for a new user authentication (keep current authentication settings), or successful attempt for a new user authentication (initialize new Authenticated State with new authentication settings). |
    | 5 | Leave Authenticated State | De-authentication routine, or timeout. |
    | 6 | Leave Authenticated State | ECU reset. |
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：Yes
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Controls access to diagnostic functions, ensuring only authorized users can perform restricted operations.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：not applicable
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2086_Access Control List Types**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2086
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Access Control List Types
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.3 Secure diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.3.3 Right management>3.3.14.1.4.3.3.1 未分组
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    Three types of AccessControlLists are evaluated: The Basic AccessControlList, the ECU-individual AccessControlList and the Enhanced AccessControlList. The Basic AccessControlList contains all basic diagnostic services necessary including the ones for authentication, updating the actual AccessControlList and reprogramming an ECU. Basic diagnostic services are all diagnostic services standardized in “DDS S-ISO14229 DSUDS”. The ECU-individual AccessControlList is defined by the developer and contains all diagnostic services that are individual for the respective ECU. The Enhanced AccessControlList is a temporary AccessControlList which will be created using RoutineControl “Enhance Access Rights”.

###### 3.3.14.1.4.3.4 Security access
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2089_Security Access Authentication**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2089
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Security Access Authentication
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.3 Secure diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.3.4 Security access
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The Security Access is based on an asymmetric algorithm provided by the Standard Security Architecture: On Security Access service with request Seed parameter, the Standard Security Architecture generates a random number as the seed. The Diagnostic Test Tool then signs this seed with the SecurityAccessPrivateKey and send the signature back using a SecurityAccess request with sendKey parameter. The Standard Security Architecture verifies the key (i.e. the signature) using its internal SecurityAccessPublicKey. If the signature verification is successful, the Standard Security Architecture sets the appropriate Security Level. For diagnostic services secured with this Security Level, the ECU can check whether the level is set or not and then execute the corresponding service.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：Yes
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; operates within ECU software.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：not applicable
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2102_ROL_Rollo_Status**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2102
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：ROL_Rollo_Status
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.1 Actual Values
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall expose a secured UDS diagnostic command **DID `0x0501` `ROL_Rollo_Status`** to read the current Rollo status parameters.
    
    ## Temperatures
    
    | Parameter | Unit | Min | Max |
    |---|---|---:|---:|
    | Rollo motor calculated coil temperature | °C | −40 | +215 |
    | Rollo motor calculated case temperature | °C | −40 | +215 |
    
    ## Status flags
    
    | Byte | Bit / Field | Value / Range |
    |---|---|---|
    | Byte 4 | Closed | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 4 | Partially opened | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 4 | Fully opened | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 5 | Normed | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 5 | Normed valid | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 5 | Is moving | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 5 | Reference field valid | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 5 | Anti-pinch available | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 5 | Close position reached | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 6 | Thermal protection | `Not Active: 0` / `Active: 1` / `Not Available: 2` |
    | Byte 6 | Maximum motor run time exceeded | `Active: 1` / `Not Active: 0` |
    | Byte 6 | Block reached | `Active: 1` / `Not Active: 0` |
    | Byte 6 | Counting polarity | `Counting down: 1` / `Counting up: 0` |
    
    Rollo Comfort control stored position
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：Yes
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Provides diagnostic access to Rollo status parameters via secured UDS command, no direct environmental impact.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After authentication completed, request the DID [0x0501] "ROL_Rollo_Status" per diagnostic

Success Criteria:

Reply positive response and the presented rollo status is correct
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：外部接口测试 External Interface Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

    The SCU shall expose a secured UDS diagnostic command **DID `0x0401` `GLA_Glass Panel Status`** to read the current glass-panel status parameters.
    ## Temperatures
    | Parameter | Unit | Min | Max |
    |---|---|---:|---:|
    | Glass-panel motor calculated coil temperature | °C | −40 | +215 |
    | Glass-panel motor calculated case temperature | °C | −40 | +215 |
    
    ## Status flags
    | Byte | Bit / Field | Value / Range |
    |---|---|---|
    | Byte 4 | Closed | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 4 | Partially opened | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 4 | Fully opened | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 4 | Tilted | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 4 | Fully tilted | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 4 | Tilt anti-boom position reached | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 4 | Slide anti-boom position reached | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 5 | Normed | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 5 | Normed valid | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 5 | Is moving | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 5 | Reference field valid | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 5 | Anti-pinch available | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 5 | Close position reached | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 5 | Presafe position reached | `YES` / `NO` |
    | Byte 6 | Thermal protection | `Not Active: 0` / `Active: 1` / `Not Available: 2` |
    | Byte 6 | Maximum motor run time exceeded | `Active` / `Not Active` |
    | Byte 6 | Block reached | `Not Active: 0` / `Active: 1` |
    | Byte 6 | Counting polarity | `Counting down: 0` / `Counting up: 1` |
    | Byte 7 | Dynamic Rain Close status | `0: SNA`, `1: deactivated`, `2: monitoring`, `3: rain detected`, `4: active`, `5: temp. disabled`, `6: ign. cycle disabled` |
    | Byte 7 | Dynamic Variable Tilt status | `0: SNA`, `1: deactivated`, `2: not active`, `3: temp deactivated`, `4: active` |
    | Byte 7 | Backflow reduction status | `0: Inactive`, `1: Active` |
    | Byte 7 | Glass-panel ATS escalation level | `0: Base Level`, `1: Override Level 1`, `2: Override Level 2` |
    
    Glass-panel HVAC stored position

- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2095_SCU_UI_Command_Status**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2095
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：SCU_UI_Command_Status
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.1 Actual Values
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall expose a secured UDS diagnostic command **DID `0x0305` `SCU_UI_Command_Status`** to read the UI command status.
    
    ## UI Command Status
    
    | Command | Description |
    |---|---|
    | `GD_MOVE_TO_POS` | Move the glass panel to the requested position |
    | `GD_OPEN_MAN` | Open the glass panel manually |
    | `GD_OPEN_AUTO` | Open the glass panel automatically |
    | `GD_CLOSE_MAN` | Close the glass panel manually |
    | `GD_CLOSE_AUTO` | Close the glass panel automatically |
    | `RB_MOVE_TO_POS` | Move the Rollo to the requested position |
    | `RB_OPEN_MAN` | Open the Rollo manually |
    | `RB_OPEN_AUTO` | Open the Rollo automatically |
    | `RB_CLOSE_MAN` | Close the Rollo manually |
    | `RB_CLOSE_AUTO` | Close the Rollo automatically |
    
    ## UI Input Interface Status
    
    | Value | Status |
    |---:|---|
    | `0` | Unlocked |
    | `1` | Locked |
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：Yes
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Provides secure access to UI command status via UDS, ensuring authorized control of glass panel and Rollo operations.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After authentication completed, request the DID [0x0305] "SCU_UI_Command_Status" per diagnostic

Success Criteria:

Reply positive response and the presented status of the UI command should be.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2157_ROL_Stop Reason**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2157
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：ROL_Stop Reason
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.2 Stored Data
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall expose a secured UDS diagnostic command **DID `0x0505` `ROL_Stop reason`** to read the Rollo stop-reason history.
    
    ## Recording rules
    
    - Only stop reasons recorded with a **new odometer value** shall be stored.
    - The history holds **10 items**.
    - The associated odometer value is recorded in **steps of 16 km**.
    
    ## Stop reason codes
    
    | Code | Description |
    |---:|---|
    | 0 | No Stop Reason |
    | 1 | Internal debug purposes |
    | 2 | Diagnostic request |
    | 3 | Block in open is simulated |
    | 4 | Block in close is simulated |
    | 5 | User request, panic abort |
    | 6 | Conflicting commands |
    | 7 | Conditions for automatic movements not given |
    | 8 | Maximum open limitation feature |
    | 9 | Resume timer has expired |
    | 10 | Paused due to cold crank |
    | 11 | Paused due to warm crank |
    | 12 | Klamp 15 precondition is not given |
    | 13 | KG patch check was not successful |
    | 14 | Load dump event |
    | 15 | Motion type is disabled |
    | 16 | Motor assignment was changed |
    | 17 | Start or running preconditions are not met |
    | 18 | Multiple command requests |
    | 19 | Command is SNA |
    | 20 | Command transition from SNA |
    | 21 | Motor (target) is not configured |
    | 22 | Aborted due to cold crank |
    | 23 | Aborted due to warm crank |
    | 24 | Block has been detected during a relax movement |
    | 25 | Pinching has been detected during a relax movement |
    | 26 | End of a time-based bounce-back movement |
    | 27 | End of a bounce-back movement |
    | 28 | Block in open direction |
    | 29 | Block in close direction |
    | 30 | No reason was set |
    | 31 | Maximum motor activation was exceeded |
    | 32 | Problem with the close relay |
    | 33 | Problem with the open relay |
    | 34 | Hall sensor is not operable |
    | 35 | Direction hall sensor error |
    | 36 | Capture hall sensor error |
    | 37 | Motor is not normed |
    | 38 | Implausible position was detected |
    | 39 | Hall supply is not stable |
    | 40 | Undervoltage at start was detected |
    | 41 | Overvoltage at start was detected |
    | 42 | Undervoltage was detected |
    | 43 | Overvoltage was detected |
    | 44 | Relax from block in close direction was finished |
    | 45 | Relax from block in open direction was finished |
    | 46 | Intermittent motion step |
    | 47 | Block was detected while doing a reversal movement |
    | 48 | Too high forces occurred while doing a reversal movement |
    | 49 | Normalization was lost |
    | 50 | Thermal protection at start |
    | 51 | Thermal protection during run |
    | 60 | Internal problem of the motor driver |
    | 61 | Incompatible Anti-Pinch parameter set |
    | 62 | Position counting is not possible |
    | 63 | Hardware control failure |
    | 64 | Invalid parameter set for carline / bodystyle / roofstyle |
    | 65 | Incompatible User Interface parameter set |
    | 66 | Parameter set mismatch |
    | 67 | Implausible parameter |
    | 68 | No motor driver algorithm was set |
    | 69 | Unknown motor driver algorithm was set |
    | 70 | Maximum allowed time was exceeded |
    | 71 | Short between Capture and Direction hall sensors |
    | 72 | Exchange between Capture and Direction hall sensors |
    | 73 | Rapid voltage drop event |
    | 74 | SBC thermal protection warning |
    | 75 | SBC thermal protection critical |
    | 76 | L99H01 thermal protection warning |
    | 78 | L99H01 thermal protection critical |
    | 79 | VIN was changed |
    | 80 | Motor is started |
    | 81 | Bridge driver error |
    | 82 | Target position was reached |
    | 83 | Target movements not possible |
    | 84 | Start request timeout, battery sensor circuit fault |
    | 85 | Stop for motor turn, current sensor circuit fault |
    | 86 | Motor driver initialized, anti-pinch is detected |
    | 87 | Maximum activation time has expired, reference field is lost |
    | 88 | Emergency stop |
    | 89 | Low power was forced |
    | 90 | Mechanic relaxation completed |
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：Yes
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Provides diagnostic access to stop-reason history via UDS, no direct environmental impact.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After authentication completed, request the  DID [0x0505] "ROL_Stop reason" per diagnostic

Success Criteria:

Reply positive response and the last 10 rollo stop reasons and the relevant odometer are presented.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2155_ROL_Motor Label Content**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2155
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：ROL_Motor Label Content
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.2 Stored Data
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall expose a secured UDS diagnostic command **DID `0x0503` `ROL_Motor Label Content`** to read and write the Rollo motor label content.
    
    ## Data structure
    
    | Field | Size (Bytes) | Description / Range |
    |---|---:|---|
    | Motor supplier part number | 6 | Part number assigned by the motor supplier |
    | Motor supplier production plant | 1 | Identifier of the supplier production plant |
    | Motor production date | 6 | Date in `YY-MM-DD` format |
    | Motor production shift | 1 | Identifier of the production shift |
    | Motor production EOL tester number | 1 | Identifier of the EOL tester |
    | Motor serial number | 7 | Serial number of the motor |
    | IRS motor part number | 5 | Last 5 digits of the motor part number |
    | IRS motor revision | 1 | Hardware / software revision of the IRS motor |
    | Motor TNI slope CW | 1 | Default `133` (equals `13.3 RPM/Nm`); Min `98`; Max `180` |
    | Motor TNI slope CCW | 1 | Default `133` (equals `13.3 RPM/Nm`); Min `98`; Max `180` |
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：Yes
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects diagnostic interface and data integrity.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After authentication completed, request the DID [0x0503] "ROL_Motor Label Content" to update the label information per diagnostic;

Power off and on, perform authentication agian;

Request theDID [0x0503] "ROL_Motor Label Content" to read the label information per diagnostic;

Success Criteria:

After power and on, the updated label position information is presented.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：外部接口测试 External Interface Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：
