**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2146_GLA_Glass Panel Stop Reason**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2146
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：GLA_Glass Panel Stop Reason
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.2 Stored Data
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall expose a secured UDS diagnostic command **DID `0x0405` `GLA_Glass panel Stop reason`** to read the glass-panel stop-reason history.
    
    ## Recording rules
    
    - Only stop reasons recorded with a **new odometer value** shall be stored.
    - The history holds **10 items**.
    - The associated odometer value is recorded in **steps of 16 km**.
    
    ## Stop reason codes
    
    | Code | Description |
    |---:|---|
    | 0 | No Stop Reason |
    | 1 | Internal debug purposes |
    | 2 | Diagnostic request |
    | 3 | Block in open is simulated |
    | 4 | Block in close is simulated |
    | 5 | User request, panic abort |
    | 6 | Conflicting commands |
    | 7 | Conditions for automatic movements not given |
    | 8 | Maximum open limitation feature |
    | 9 | Resume timer has expired |
    | 10 | Paused due to cold crank |
    | 11 | Paused due to warm crank |
    | 12 | Klamp 15 precondition is not given |
    | 13 | KG patch check was not successful |
    | 14 | Load dump event |
    | 15 | Motion type is disabled |
    | 16 | Motor assignment was changed |
    | 17 | Start or running preconditions are not met |
    | 18 | Multiple command requests |
    | 19 | Command is SNA |
    | 20 | Command transition from SNA |
    | 21 | Motor (target) is not configured |
    | 22 | Aborted due to cold crank |
    | 23 | Aborted due to warm crank |
    | 24 | Block has been detected during a relax movement |
    | 25 | Pinching has been detected during a relax movement |
    | 26 | End of a time-based bounce-back movement |
    | 27 | End of a bounce-back movement |
    | 28 | Block in open direction |
    | 29 | Block in close direction |
    | 30 | No reason was set |
    | 31 | Maximum motor activation was exceeded |
    | 32 | Problem with the close relay |
    | 33 | Problem with the open relay |
    | 34 | Hall sensor is not operable |
    | 35 | Direction hall sensor error |
    | 36 | Capture hall sensor error |
    | 37 | Motor is not normed |
    | 38 | Implausible position was detected |
    | 39 | Hall supply is not stable |
    | 40 | Undervoltage at start was detected |
    | 41 | Overvoltage at start was detected |
    | 42 | Undervoltage was detected |
    | 43 | Overvoltage was detected |
    | 44 | Relax from block in close direction was finished |
    | 45 | Relax from block in open direction was finished |
    | 46 | Intermittent motion step |
    | 47 | Block was detected while doing a reversal movement |
    | 48 | Too high forces occurred while doing a reversal movement |
    | 49 | Normalization was lost |
    | 50 | Thermal protection at start |
    | 51 | Thermal protection during run |
    | 60 | Internal problem of the motor driver |
    | 61 | Incompatible Anti-Pinch parameter set |
    | 62 | Position counting is not possible |
    | 63 | Hardware control failure |
    | 64 | Invalid parameter set for carline / bodystyle / roofstyle |
    | 65 | Incompatible User Interface parameter set |
    | 66 | Parameter set mismatch |
    | 67 | Implausible parameter |
    | 68 | No motor driver algorithm was set |
    | 69 | Unknown motor driver algorithm was set |
    | 70 | Maximum allowed time was exceeded |
    | 71 | Short between Capture and Direction hall sensors |
    | 72 | Exchange between Capture and Direction hall sensors |
    | 73 | Rapid voltage drop event |
    | 74 | SBC thermal protection warning |
    | 75 | SBC thermal protection critical |
    | 76 | L99H01 thermal protection warning |
    | 78 | L99H01 thermal protection critical |
    | 79 | VIN was changed |
    | 80 | Motor is started |
    | 81 | Bridge driver error |
    | 82 | Target position was reached |
    | 83 | Target movements not possible |
    | 84 | Start request timeout, battery sensor circuit fault |
    | 85 | Stop for motor turn, current sensor circuit fault |
    | 86 | Motor driver initialized, anti-pinch is detected |
    | 87 | Maximum activation time has expired, reference field lost |
    | 88 | Emergency stop |
    | 89 | Low power was forced |
    | 90 | Mechanic relaxation completed |
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：Yes
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects diagnostic data availability.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After authentication completed, request the  DID [0x0405] "GLA_Glass panel Stop reason" per diagnostic

Success Criteria:

Reply positive response and the last 10 glass panel stop reasons and the relevant odometer are presented.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2144_GLA_Motor Label Content**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2144
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：GLA_Motor Label Content
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.2 Stored Data
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall expose a secured UDS diagnostic command **DID `0x0403` `GLA_Motor Label Content`** to read and write the glass-panel motor label content.
    
    ## Data structure
    
    | Field | Size (Bytes) | Description / Range |
    |---|---:|---|
    | Motor supplier part number | 6 | Part number assigned by the motor supplier |
    | Motor supplier production plant | 1 | Identifier of the supplier production plant |
    | Motor production date | 6 | Date in `YY-MM-DD` format |
    | Motor production shift | 1 | Identifier of the production shift |
    | Motor production EOL tester number | 1 | Identifier of the EOL tester |
    | Motor serial number | 7 | Serial number of the motor |
    | IRS motor part number | 5 | Last 5 digits of the motor part number |
    | IRS motor revision | 1 | Hardware / software revision of the IRS motor |
    | Motor TNI slope CW | 1 | Default `110` (equals `11.0 RPM/Nm`); Min `81`; Max `148` |
    | Motor TNI slope CCW | 1 | Default `110` (equals `11.0 RPM/Nm`); Min `81`; Max `148` |
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：Yes
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects diagnostic communication and data integrity.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After authentication completed, request the DID [0x0403] "GLA_Motor Label Content" to update the label information per diagnostic;

Power off and on, perform authentication agian;

Request the DID [0x0403] "GLA_Motor Label Content" to read the label information per diagnostic;

Success Criteria:

After power and on, the updated label position information is presented.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：外部接口测试 External Interface Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

- 评审人：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2135_RCS_Reason for Rain Close**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2135
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：RCS_Reason for Rain Close
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.2 Stored Data
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall expose a secured UDS diagnostic command **DID `0x0A00` `RCS_Reason for Rain Close`** to read the Rain Close reason history.
    
    ## Recording rules
    
    - Only Rain Close reasons recorded with a **new odometer value** shall be stored.
    - The history holds **10 items**.
    - The associated odometer value is recorded in **steps of 16 km**.
    
    ## Rain Close reason codes
    
    | Code | Description |
    |---:|---|
    | 0 | No Rain Close since initialisation |
    | 1 | Closed on request of Rain Close master |
    | 2 | Lost communication with Close master |
    | 3 | Pinching reversal |
    | 4 | Roof voltage error |
    | 5 | Anti-Pinch not enabled |
    | 6 | Roof is denormed |
    | 7 | Other roof function active |
    | 8 | Shortcut on Hall supply |
    | 9 | Invalid preconditions |
    | 10 | Panic function |
    | 14 | Invalid motor direction detected |
    | 15 | Close requested by low-power switch |
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：Yes
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Provides diagnostic access to rain close history via UDS, no direct environmental impact.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After authentication completed, request the DID [0x0A00] "RCS_Reason for Rain Close" per diagnostic

Success Criteria:

Reply positive response and the last 10 rain close reasons and the relevent odometers are presented.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：外部接口测试 External Interface Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2119_DTC Usage Histogram**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2119
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：DTC Usage Histogram
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.2 Stored Data

- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall have a (UDS) secured diagnostic command DID [0x0105] "DTC_Usage_Histogram" to retrieve logs from the ECU for in-use performance data (e.g. load spectrum, RPM, requested torque, vehicle speed etc.) to provide a histogram of the overall usage over the lifetime of a vehicle. As the data is intended to be used for engineering purposes only the data is provided as a Hex dump to prevent the data from being analyzed in the dealership. [Source: MGU00000426_2019_09] Hexdump Usage Data (All BLK-IDs are attached after each other)
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Provides diagnostic data access via UDS, no direct environmental impact.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After authentication completed, request the DID [0x0105] "DTC_Usage_Histogram" per diagnostic

Success Criteria:

Reply positive response and the the operation records is presented according to the specific format.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test
- Comment：

Reply positive response and the the operation records is presented according to the specific format.

- Sources：External

- Allocation：SW

- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2244_Runin Diagnostic Routine**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2244
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Runin Diagnostic Routine
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.7 Routine Control
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The system shall have a (UDS) secured diagnostic command DID [0x1651] "Inalfa_RunIn Movements" to start, stop and request results from operating glass panel and rollo motor in parallel for a specified amount of cycles. Routine Start parameters: RunIn cycles: amount of cycles; minimum 1; maximum 255; step 1; default 1 Cycle Delay: miliseconds delay between cycles; resolution 10msec; minimum 0; maximum 65535; default 1 Motor Activation Delay: miliseconds delay between motor activation; resolution 10msec; minimum 0; maximum 65535; default 500 Delta position; unit hall; minimum 0; maximum 65535; step 1; default 300 Routine Request Results: Routine status Routine Execution time Info: Routine Behavior: Rollo moves towards open After 'motor activation delay', glass starts moving towards open (when 'delta position' is satisfied between Rollo and Glass positions) Glass moves towards close After 'motor activation delay', rollo starts moving towards close (when 'delta position' is satisfied between Rollo and Glass positions) When both panels are in Full Close, after 'cycle delay', jump back to first step and redo this a total of 'runin cycles' times
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Controls glass panel and rollo motor movements for run-in cycles, affecting vehicle sunroof operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After authentication completed,

Request a pre-defined run-in sequence for the glass panel and motor via the DID [0X1651] "Inalfa_RunIn Movements";

Success Criteria:

The movement running sequences of the glass panel and rollo are as expected.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,性能测试 Performance Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2258_Secure Diagnostic Command**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2258
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Secure Diagnostic Command
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.8 Synchronous Routine

- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall have a (UDS) secured diagnostic command DID [0x0264] "MBC_Replace Certificates" to replace the currently stored ECU Certificate, Backend CA Certificate or Root CA Certificate. The Root CA Certificate may only be replaced together with the Backend CA Certificate. The Backend CA Certificate may only be exchanged together with the ECU Certificate. [Source: DDS_S-ISO14229_2016-06].
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：Yes
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects secure communication and certificate management.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After authentication completed,

Request DID [0x0264] "MBC_Replace Certificates" in diagnostic

Success Criteria:

The ECU certificate can be replaced by the new one.

Note: The security relevant requirements will be tested automatically using Daimler's NEST software, and the diagnostic relevant requirements will be also validated using CANoe Diva and Daimler test pattern. There should be no failure points after the automatical validation per the specific tools.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：外部接口测试 External Interface Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2289_MBC_System Reference Learn Run**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2289
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：MBC_System Reference Learn Run
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.9 Asynchronous Routine
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall expose a UDS + MBC secured diagnostic command **DID `0x1850` `MBC_System Reference Learn Run`** to start, stop, and request the result of the reference-position and reference-field learning for both motors.
    
    > Authorisation is required in Daimler's production environment.
    
    | Field | Description |
    |---|---|
    | Routine result | Result code of the routine (see table below) |
    | Routine execution time | Total time the routine ran |
    
    ## Routine result codes
    
    | Code | Status |
    |---:|---|
    | 0 | Completed |
    | 1 | On going |
    | 2 | Failed – under voltage |
    | 3 | Failed – over voltage |
    | 4 | Failed – Hall error |
    | 5 | Aborted by CAN switch |
    | 6 | Aborted by diagnostic |
    | 7 | Aborted because of busy motor |
    | 8 | Mechanical learning not allowed |
    | 9 | Motor not normed |
    | 10 | Diagnostic movements not allowed |
    | 11 | Crank event |
    | 12 | Motor assignment |
    | 13 | Relay error |
    | 14 | Thermal protection active |
    | 15 | Motor driver error |
    | 16 | Parameter set problem |
    | 17 | Block during movement |
    | 18 | Aborted – other |
    | 255 | Routine never started |
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：Yes
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Enables secure diagnostic learning of motor reference positions, affecting motor control and safety.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Request DID [0x1850] "MBC_System Reference Learn Run" in diagnostic

Success Criteria:

The glass panel and rollo norming and RF learning parallelly process is started/stopped, or routine result is shown.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2287_Inalfa secured diagnostic command**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2287
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Inalfa secured diagnostic command
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.9 Asynchronous Routine
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall expose a UDS + Inalfa secured diagnostic command **DID `0x1655` `Inalfa_Reference Learn Run Parallel`** to start, stop, and request the result of the reference-position and reference-field learning for **both motors in parallel**.
    
    | Field | Description |
    |---|---|
    | Routine result | Result code of the routine (see table below) |
    
    ## Routine result codes
    
    | Code | Status |
    |---:|---|
    | 0 | Completed |
    | 1 | On going |
    | 2 | Failed – under voltage |
    | 3 | Failed – over voltage |
    | 4 | Failed – Hall error |
    | 5 | Aborted by CAN switch |
    | 6 | Aborted by diagnostic |
    | 7 | Aborted because of busy motor |
    | 8 | Mechanical learning not allowed |
    | 9 | Motor not normed |
    | 10 | Diagnostic movements not allowed |
    | 11 | Crank event |
    | 12 | Motor assignment |
    | 13 | Relay error |
    | 14 | Thermal protection active |
    | 15 | Motor driver error |
    | 16 | Parameter set problem |
    | 17 | Block during movement |
    | 18 | Aborted – other |
    | 255 | Routine never started |
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects diagnostic communication and motor learning process.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After authentication completed,

Request DID [0x1655] "Inalfa_Reference Learn Run Parallel" in diagnostic

Success Criteria:

The glass panel and rollo norming and RF learning parallelly process is started/stopped, or routine result is shown.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2286_Rollo Reference Field**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2286
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Rollo Reference Field
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.9 Asynchronous Routine
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    This routine will execute the following sequencial steps: 
    1. Close the Rollo to the **Full Close** position.
    2. Unset the Rollo Reference Field validity to **valid**.
    3. Open the Rollo to the **Full Open** position.
    4. Store the Rollo **Open Reference Field**.
    5. Close the Rollo to the **Full Close** position.
    6. Store the Rollo **Close Reference Field**.
    7. Set the Rollo Reference Field validity to **valid**.
    
    ## Start conditions
    
    The routine start conditions are the same as those defined in `SYS-5659` and `SYS-5661`.
    
    Additionally, the Rollo Reference Point validity must be **valid**.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on environment; routine operates on Rollo position and reference fields.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：not applicable
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2280_Asynchronous Routine**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2280
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Asynchronous Routine
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.9 Asynchronous Routine

- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    This routine will execute the following sequencial steps: unset Glass panel Reference Point validity unset Rollo Reference Point validity; unset Glass panel Reference Field validity; unset Rollo Reference Field validity; Close Glass panel untill Motor Stall detected; Set Glass panel Reference Point to 0; Close Rollo untill Motor Stall detected; Set Rollo Reference Point to 0; Open Rollo to 'Full Open' position; Set Rollo Reference Point validity to Valid; Store Rollo Open Reference Field; Open Glass panel to 'Full Open' position; Set Glass panel Reference Point validity to Valid; Store Glass panel Open Reference Field; Close Glass panel to 'Full Close' position; Store Glass panel Close Reference Field; set Glass panel Reference Field validity to valid; Close Rollo to 'Full Close' position; Store Rollo Close Reference Field; set Rollo Reference Field validity to valid; Open Rollo to 'Full Open' position; The start conditions for this routine are the same as defined in SYS-5621 and SYS-5623,
- SysReqType：Function

- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Controls glass panel and rollo positions, affecting vehicle window and sunroof operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：not applicable
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2276_MBC Sync to NVM**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2276
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：MBC Sync to NVM
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.9 Asynchronous Routine
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall have a (UDS) secured diagnostic command DID [0x0245] "MBC_Synchronize to Non-volatile Memory" to synchronize data from volatile memory to non-volatile memory without performing an ECUReset. [Source: DDS_S-ISO14229_2016-06].
- SysReqType：Interface
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on physical environment; affects diagnostic communication and data storage.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After authentication completed,

Request DID [0x0245] "MBC_Synchronize to Non-volatile Memory" in diagnostic

Success Criteria:

The variables (stored in the EEPROM) values in RAM will be synchronized to the EEPROM without MCU reset.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,外部接口测试 External Interface Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2275_Mbc_ecu I/o Test**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2275
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Mbc_ecu I/o Test
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.9 Asynchronous Routine
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall have a (UDS) secured diagnostic command DID [0x0219] "MBC_ECU I/O Test" to activate all I/Os of an ECU which can be executed without manual interaction (automatic testing) to ensure checking for all DTCs only testable with functionality turned on. The I/Os shall be activated until the mature criteria of the DTC is set and afterwards automatically be deactivated. [Source: DDS_S-ISO14229_2016-06].
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Activates all I/Os of an ECU during testing, which may temporarily affect connected systems or loads.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After authentication completed,

Request DID [0x0219] "MBC_ECU I/O Test" in diagnostic

Success Criteria:

The ECU I/O self test will be executed automatically.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2274_Fail-Safe Reaction Deactivation**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2274
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Fail-Safe Reaction Deactivation
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.1 Diagnostics>3.3.14.1.4 Diagnostic Communication>3.3.14.1.4.4 Diagnostic Routines>3.3.14.1.4.4.9 Asynchronous Routine
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall have a (UDS) secured diagnostic command DID [0x0204] "MBC_Control Fail-Safe Reactions" to temporarily deactivate all Fail-Safe Reaction software routines which would run as part of the ECU Application Software if a loss of communication (no message received from remote ECU) occurs. The RID may not be implemented for a certain ECU, if disabling fail-safe reactions is forbidden by law for this ECU. [Source: DDS_S-ISO14229_2016-06].
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Temporarily disables fail-safe reactions during loss of communication, potentially affecting system safety.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After authentication completed,

Request DID [0x0204] "MBC_Control Fail-Safe Reactions" in diagnostic

Success Criteria:

The fail safe reaction can be temporarily deactivated.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

    The SCU shall execute the Asynchronous diagnostic routine "SCU_System Reference Learn Run" in the following sequencial steps: unset Glass panel Reference Point validity unset Rollo Reference Point validity; unset Glass panel Reference Field validity; unset Rollo Reference Field validity; Close Glass panel untill Motor Stall detected; Set Glass panel Reference Point to 0; Close Rollo untill Motor Stall detected; Set Rollo Reference Point to 0; Open Rollo to 'Full Open' position; Set Rollo Reference Point validity to Valid; Store Rollo Open Reference Field; Open Glass panel to 'Full Open' position; Set Glass panel Reference Point validity to Valid; Store Glass panel Open Reference Field; Close Glass panel to 'Full Close' position; Store Glass panel Close Reference Field; set Glass panel Reference Field validity to valid; Close Rollo to 'Full Close' position; Store Rollo Close Reference Field; set Rollo Reference Field validity to valid; Open Rollo to 'Full Open' position;
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Controls glass panel and rollo positions, affecting vehicle interior environment.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Configure all the conditions listed in the pre-conditions and functional requirements are satisfied,

perform the authentication,

request diagnostic routine "SCU_System Reference Learn Run" ;

Success Criteria:

The glass panel and rollo norming and RF learning process is started, the sequences is same as the description in this requirement.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

Or send a operation request via CANoe panel;

Or make a SCU drive circuit fault;

Success Criteria:

The glass panel and rollo norming and RF learning process should be aborted.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test

- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Motor Stall Detection

- Sources：External
- Rationale：

- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Releases mechanical tension in roller shutter to prevent damage.
- Verification Method：测试Test

Finishe the rollo norming process;

Success Criteria:

Rollo position information can be read out.

- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-656_Fault Detection List**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-656
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Fault Detection List
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.1 未分组
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall detect the faults including:
       
    
        - Incorrect Configuration
       
    
        - VIN number unmatched
       
    
        - Startup process not finished
       
    
        - Authentication denied
       
    
        - Hall Sensor Failures
       
    
        - GPA 1st hall failure
       
    
        - GPA 2nd hall failure
       
    
        - Rollo 1st hall failure
       
    
        - Rollo 2nd hall failure
       
    
        - Rollo Motor Hall Power Supply Out of Range
       
    
        - Rollo motor hall power supply open circuit
       
    
        - Rollo motor hall power supply STG
       
    
        - Motor Interface
       
    
        - GLA driving circuit failure
       
    
        - GLA CCW pin STB - Pin1
       
    
        - GLA CW pin STB - Pin2
       
    
        - GLA motor open circuit
       
    
        - ROL driving circuit failure
       
    
        - ROL CCW pin STB - Pin1
       
    
        - ROL CW pin STG - Pin2
       
    
        - ROL motor open circuit
       
    
        - Motor Current Sensing 
       
    
        - GLA current sensing circuit failure
       
    
        - Rollo current sesing circuit failure
       
    
        - Motor TNI unmatch
       
    
        - GLA motor TNI unmatch
       
    
        - ROL motor TNI unmatch
       
    
        - Corrupted Parameter File
       
    
        - No parameter hex file 
       
    
        - Incorrect parameter hex file
       
    
        - PCBA Ambient temperature out of range
       
    
        - CAN Bus off
       
    
        - AD sampling fault
       
    
        - EVC
       
    
        - EVC state mismatch
       
    
        - EVC configuration mismatch
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Detects faults in system components, ensuring safe operation and preventing potential hazards.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：not applicable
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

###### 3.3.14.2.2 Incorrect Configuration Faults
###### 3.3.14.2.2.1 VIN Number Unmatched
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-666_VIN Number Unmatched Fault**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-666
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：VIN Number Unmatched Fault
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.2 Incorrect Configuration Faults>3.3.14.2.2.1 VIN Number Unmatched
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall not recover from VIN Number Unmatched fault in the subsequent Ignition cycles unless the historical DTC has been cleared via diagnostics routine has been performed.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Prevents vehicle operation with mismatched VIN, ensuring correct configuration.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

A: When VIN is incorrect DTC is reported, then reste IGN or power

B: Correct the CAN-bus VIN to consistent with stored VIN

Success Criteria

A: DTC is not clear

B: DTC is cleared
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-665_VIN Match**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-665
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：VIN Match
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.2 Incorrect Configuration Faults>3.3.14.2.2.1 VIN Number Unmatched
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When the stored VINorginal == the valid VIN on CAN, the SCU shall not raise VIN Number Unmatched fault.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on the operating environment.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Change the VIN on CAN-bus to make it different from stored VIN;

Then recover the VIN to that same with the stored VIN;

Success Criteria

After 5s, the following situations will occur

1. Aborted any on-going motor movement except reversal

2. Denorm Glass Panel and Rollo by erasing their RP's and RF's in NVM

3. Set DTC P164456.

After the VIN on the CAN bus recovers;

the DTC will be in the history session.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-664_VIN Mismatch Fault**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-664
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：VIN Mismatch Fault
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.2 Incorrect Configuration Faults>3.3.14.2.2.1 VIN Number Unmatched
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When the stored VINorginal and the valid VIN on CAN do not match for 5s, the SCU shall
       
    
        - stop any on-going motor movement except reversal;
       
    
        - denorm Glass Panel and Rollo by erasing their RP's and RF's in NVM;
       
    
        - set both STATUS_Norming_Glass_Panel & STATUS_Norming_Rollo to Denormed;
       
    
        - raise a VIN Number Unmatched fault;
       
    
        - set DTC P164456.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Stops motor movement and denormalizes glass panel and rollo, affecting window and sunroof operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Change the VIN on CAN-bus to make it different from stored VIN

Success Criteria

After 5s, follow situation will occur

1. Aborted any on-going motor movement except reversal

2. Denorm Glass Panel and Rollo by erasing their RP's and RF's in NVM

3. Set DTC P164456.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-662_VIN Unmatched Fault**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-662
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：VIN Unmatched Fault
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.2 Incorrect Configuration Faults>3.3.14.2.2.1 VIN Number Unmatched
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When the VIN on CAN is invalid, the SCU shall not raise VIN Number Unmatched fault.

- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：

- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Prevents false fault indication, ensuring correct diagnostic status in vehicle.
- Verification Method：测试Test

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-686_Hall Fault Clear**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-686
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Hall Fault Clear
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.4 Hall Faults>3.3.14.2.4.2 Hall Signal Faults

- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
       
    
        any hall fault is present; (i.e. GPA 1st/2nd, Rollo 1st/2nd Hall Failure)
       
    
        AND
       
    
        the Glass Panel or Rollo is operating stepwisely; 
       
    
        AND
       
    
        there has been 10 normal pulses from the 1st Hall and 10 normal pulses from the 2nd Hall arrived in the alternating pattern;
       
    
        the SCU shall clear the single hall fault. (i.e Glass Panel or Rollo renorming is possible)
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：

- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample

- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

After hall failure detected, remove the hall failure injection, then operate the glass panel/rollo to move;

Success Criteria:

Only stepwise operation in close direction for the glass panel/rollo ever had the hall failure is available,

the DTC should be in the history session.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test

    When the SCU has 10 more pulses in one Rollo Motor Hall than the other, the SCU shall 
       
    
        - stop Rollo motor;
       
    
        - raise Hall Failure for the one with less pulse count;
       
    
        - set DTC for the Hall with Failure (B187309 for Rollo 1st Hall, B187709 for Rollo 2nd Hall Failure)
       
    
        - erase Rollo RP & RF in NVM;
       
    
        - set STATUS_Norming_Rollo = Denormed.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Stops Rollo motor and raises hall failure diagnostics, affecting system operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Make the rollo hall failure during the motor movement;

Success Criteria:

Rollo movement should be aborted;

Relevant hall failure DTC is reported;

Rollo will be denormed and the RF cannot be read out per diagnostic.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-705_Rollo Motor Hall Power Supply Fault**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-705
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Rollo Motor Hall Power Supply Fault
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.4 Hall Faults>3.3.14.2.4.3 Rollo Motor Hall Power Supply Faults
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When Rollo Motor Hall Power short to ground has been detected;
       
    
        the SCU shall 
       
    
        - raise Rollo Motor Hall Power Supply Short to Ground fault;
       
    
        - set DTC B1DEF11
       
    
        - shut down Rollo Motor Hall power supply;
       
    
        - stop the Rollo motor within 100ms.
       
    
        - erase RP and RF's of Rollo Motor.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：The system detects a short to ground in the motor hall power supply and safely shuts down the motor, preventing potential damage or unsafe operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Connect the rollo motor hall power supply to the ground and then operate the rollo motor;

Success Criteria:

Relevant DTC is reported;

The rollo cannot be operated;

The Rollo should be denormed and no RF can be read out per diagnostic.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-704_SCU Hall Power Supply**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-704
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：SCU Hall Power Supply
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.4 Hall Faults>3.3.14.2.4.3 Rollo Motor Hall Power Supply Faults
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The sensor motor hall power supply is output by HS of the SBC. 
       
    
        The overcurrent limitation of HS is 150mA. If the sensor motor hall power supply is short to ground, the current will be very large. When the current exceeds the overcurrent shutdown threshold of 150mA for 20us, the SBC will turn off the output of the sensor motor hall power supply.
       
    
        After turning off the sensor motor hall power supply, SBC will transmit overcurrent and shutdown status to MCU via SPI and reset the HS.
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：HW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Protects sensor motor hall power supply from overcurrent and short circuit conditions.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：not applicable
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-693_Rollo Motor Hall Supply Voltage Fault**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-693
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Rollo Motor Hall Supply Voltage Fault
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.4 Hall Faults>3.3.14.2.4.3 Rollo Motor Hall Power Supply Faults
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
       
    
        the Rollo Motor Hall Supply Voltage fault is present;
       
    
        AND
       
    
        the measured Rollo Motor Hall Supply Voltage has been within the range [6 28V] for 100ms, 
       
    
        the SCU shall
       
    
        - clear Rollo Motor Hall Supply Voltage Out of Range fault.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Clears a fault condition in the motor hall supply voltage monitoring, restoring normal operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Connect the rollo motor hall power supply to a battery which is lower than 6V; or connect the rollo motor hall power supply to a battery which is larger than 28V;

then recover the fault injection;

Success Criteria:

The relevant DTC should be in the history session.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-692_Rollo Motor Hall Supply Voltage Fault**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-692
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Rollo Motor Hall Supply Voltage Fault
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.4 Hall Faults>3.3.14.2.4.3 Rollo Motor Hall Power Supply Faults
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When the measured Rollo Motor Hall Supply Voltage is above 27.8V for 100ms, the SCU shall
       
    
        - raise Rollo Motor Hall Supply Voltage higher than top limit;
       
    
        - set DTC B1DEF17;
       
    
        - stop any Rollo motor movement;
       
    
        - NOT operate Rollo Motor while the fault is persistent.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Prevents motor operation under overvoltage, ensuring system safety and avoiding potential damage.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Connect the rollo motor hall power supply to a battery which is larger than 28V;

Success Criteria:

Relevant DTC is reported;

The rollo cannot be operated.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

- 对象类型：需求

- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Driving Circuit Failure
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.5 Motor Interface Fault>3.3.14.2.5.2 Driving Circuit Failure

- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When a driver chip reports a fault (nFault of DRV8702 changes to low level for 10ms), the SCU shall
       
    
        - raise Driving Circuit Failure for the corresponding motor;
       
    
        - set DTC for the corresponding motor (B184901 for Glass Panel Motor, B1E7501 for Rollo Motor);
       
    
        - shut down the driver chip unless there is an ongoing reversal.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Ensures safe operation by detecting driver chip faults and shutting down motor driver to prevent damage.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

Make SCU detectes Driving Circuit Failure (nFault point short the ground);

Success Criteria:

Glass panel/rollo movement should be aborted,

report Failure DTC,

DRV8702 into Sleep Mode
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-721_Motor Phase STB Fault**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-721
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Motor Phase STB Fault
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.5 Motor Interface Fault>3.3.14.2.5.3 Motor Phase Short to Battery (MotorShort2Vbatt)
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When a Motor Phase STB has occurred, the SCU shall 
       
    
        - set the corresponding DTC
       
    
        - B1E7515 ROL CCW pin/PIN1 STB
       
    
        - B1E7511 ROL CW pin/PIN2 STB
       
    
        - B184915 GLA CCW pin/PIN1 STB
       
    
        - B184911 GLA CW pin/PIN2 STB
       
    
        - disable motor driver circuits (keep all MOSFET's open for that motor) to ensure no unintended motor movements.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Prevents unintended motor movements by disabling motor driver circuits, ensuring safe operation.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Short the follow motor PIN to battery separately:

ROL CCW pin/PIN1

ROL CW pin/PIN2

GLA CCW pin/PIN1

GLA CW pin/PIN2

Success Criteria

The corresponding DTC number is reoprted and the driver circuits is disabled.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

###### 3.3.14.2.6 Motor Current Sensing
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-734_Motor Current Sensing Fault**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-734
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Motor Current Sensing Fault
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.6 Motor Current Sensing
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When
       
    
        a Motor Current Sensing Fault is ongoing, 
       
    
        AND
       
    
        ((there is no valid command AND the sampled Glass Panel/Rollo Motor current < 0.1mA for 100ms) 
       
    
        OR 
       
    
        (there is a valid closing command AND the sampled Glass Panel/Rollo current >0.5A and <32A for 100ms)),
       
    
        the SCU shall recover from the corresponding fault.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on environment; fault recovery logic in software.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Code design review to ensure that the current sensing logic is correctly implemented in the SW.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-733_Motor Current Fault**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-733
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Motor Current Fault
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.6 Motor Current Sensing
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
       
    
        the sampled Glass Panel/Rollo current >500mA for 100ms without a valid closing command
       
    
        OR
       
    
        the sampled Glass Panel/Rollo current >32A for 100ms,
       
    
        OR
       
    
        the sampled glass panel/rollo current <500mA for 100ms with a valid closing command ;
       
    
        the SCU shall 
       
    
        - raise Current Sensing Fault for that motor;
       
    
        - set DTC B184996 (Glass Panel)/B1E7596 (Rollo);
       
    
        - stop output to the corresponding motor;
       
    
        - erase the corresponding motor's RF.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Prevents motor damage and ensures safe operation by detecting current faults.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Code design review to ensure that the current sensing logic is correctly implemented in the SW.
- Legally relevant：YES
- Test Method：故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

- 依赖：

- Sources：External
- Rationale：

Rollo should be denormed and the RF cannot be read out from the NVM.

###### 3.3.14.2.8 Corrupted Parameter File
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-741_EEPROM Failure**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-741
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：EEPROM Failure
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.8 Corrupted Parameter File

- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    If the following conditions exist, the SCU shall detect the EEPROM failure:
       
    
        - EEPROM Clock Divider Register has not been written since reset
       
    
        - Data checksum error
       
    
        - An illegal access to the flash memory caused by either a violation of the command write sequence or issuing of an illegal flash command occurs.
       
    
        - An error during execution of a flash command or during the flash reset sequence occurs.
       
    {Seems to be deleted from the table, to be discussed whether needs to be added again}
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on operating environment; detects internal EEPROM failures.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：not applicable
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

###### 3.3.14.2.9 PCBA Temperature Sensing Circuit Fault
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-744_PCBA Temperature Fault Clear**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-744
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：PCBA Temperature Fault Clear
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.9 PCBA Temperature Sensing Circuit Fault

- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
       
    
        the PCBA Temperature Out of Range Fault is present;
       
    
        AND
       
    
        the sampled temperature on the PCBA has been within the range [-40, 125degC] for more than 1s, 
       
    
        the SCU shall 
       
    
        - clear the PCBA Temperature Out of Range Fault;
       
    
        - set PCBA measured temperature to measured value(When the detected ambient temperature from CAN bus is >10℃).
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on environment; fault handling and temperature monitoring.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run Test:

When the ambient temperature from the CAN bus is larger than 10 degC;

Remove the temperature sensor from the PCBA and then recover the temperature sensor;

Success Criteria:

The relevant failure DTC should be in the history session.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

###### 3.3.14.2.10 CAN Interface
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-751_CAN Bus Off Recovery**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-751
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：CAN Bus Off Recovery
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.10 CAN Interface
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When after a CAN reset, the CAN transceiver does not report Bus Off any more, the SCU shall recover from the CAN Bus off fault.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on environment; recovery from bus off fault ensures communication stability.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

Make a bus off error for more than 3s during the normal movement or reversal process;

Power off and on;

Success Criteria

The glass panel/rollo can be normally operated and the DTC should be the history session.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-750_CAN Bus Off Fault**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-750
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：CAN Bus Off Fault
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.10 CAN Interface
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When the internal CAN transceiver has been reporting Bus Off error for 3000ms, the SCU shall
       
    
        - raise CAN Bus off fault;
       
    
        - set DTC U001988;
       
    
        - reset CAN controller;
       
    
        - stop any ongoing motor movements except reversals.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Stops motor movements except reversals to ensure safe operation during CAN bus fault.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

1. Operate the glass panel/rollo in open or close direction,

Make a bus off error for more than 3s;

2. Make a reversal when operate the glass panel/rollo in close direction,

Make a buss off error for more than 3s;

Success Criteria

1. The glass panel/rollo movement is aborted and the relevant DTC is reported;

2. The reversal will be completed and the relevant DTC is reported.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-745_CAN Busoff Fault**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-745
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：CAN Busoff Fault
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.10 CAN Interface
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
       
    
        the "CANH" is connected to 12V Ubat, 
       
    
        OR
       
    
        the "CANL" is connected to 12V Ubat,
       
    
        the SCU shall 
       
    
        - stop ongoing motor motion within 100ms and deactivate outputs to motors, OR wait for the ongoing reversal to finish then deactive outputs to motors;
       
    
        - raise CAN busoff fault;
       
    
        - report DTC U001988.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Ensures safe motor shutdown and fault reporting when CAN bus lines are shorted to battery voltage.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

1. Operate the glass panel/rollo in open or close direction,

Connect the "CANH" to the 12V Ubat or connect the "CANL" to the 12V Ubat;

2. Make a reversal when operate the glass panel/rollo in close direction,

Connect the "CANH" to the 12V Ubat or connect the "CANL" to the 12V Ubat;

Success Criteria

1. The glass panel/rollo movement is aborted and the relevant DTC is reported;

2. The reversal will be completed and the relevant DTC is reported.

- Test Method：故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test

###### 3.3.14.2.11 AD Sampling Fault
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-754_AD Sampling Fault**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-754
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：AD Sampling Fault
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.11 AD Sampling Fault
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall be possible to recover from AD Sampling Fault only in the next ignition cycle.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：No direct impact on operating environment; recovery behavior affects system availability.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

During the SCU starts up, make a malfunction that AD port is short to GND;

Power off and on;

Success Criteria:

Glass panel/Rollo operation cannot be triggered, and the DTC B222796 is reported,

After power off and on, the glass panel/rollo can be normally operated and the DTC should be in the history session.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test
- Comment：

###### 3.3.14.2.12 EVC Faults
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-758_EVC Configuration Mismatch**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-758
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：EVC Configuration Mismatch
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.12 EVC Faults
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When 
       
    
        the EVC configuration mismatch fault is present;
       
    
        AND
       
    
        the signals
       
    
        - EVC_6F_413_Avl_ST3
       
    
        - EVC_70_414_Avl_ST3
       
    
        in BC_F_BODY1_GW_Container_ST3_EVC_CfgList_4D_72_Pr5_ST3 have been matching the SCU configuration for 500ms,
       
    
        the SCU shall
       
    
        - clear the EVC configuration mismatch fault; 
       
    
        - enable motor operations.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Clears a configuration mismatch fault and enables motor operations, ensuring correct system behavior.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

After the EVC fault in SYS-RS-6545 created, then recover the EVC congiruation listed in the requirement to the value matches that stored in the EEPROM;

Success criteria:

Relevant DTC should be in the history session;

The glass panel/rollo can be operated normally.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test
- Comment：

**REQ:AF26008201-278970-757_EVC Configuration Mismatch**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-757
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：EVC Configuration Mismatch
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>3 Functional Requirement Analysis>3.3 Functional Decomposition>3.3.14 Troubleshooting>3.3.14.2 Fault Detection>3.3.14.2.12 EVC Faults
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    When the signals
       
    
        - EVC_6F_413_Avl_ST3
       
    
        - EVC_70_414_Avl_ST3
       
    
        in BC_F_BODY1_GW_Container_ST3_EVC_CfgList_4D_72_Pr5_ST3 cannot match the SCU configuration for 5s, 
       
    
        the SCU shall
       
    
        - raise the EVC configuration mismatch fault; 
       
    
        - set DTC B223B02;
       
    
        - erase all RP's and RF's;
       
    
        - disable all motor operations.
- SysReqType：Quality
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：No
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Disables motor operations and erases configurations, potentially affecting vehicle functionality.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Run test:

During the glass panel/rollo moving, change any of the EVC configuration listed in the requirement to another value which doesn't match that stored in the EEPROM for more than 5s;

Success criteria:

The glass panel/rollo movement is aborted and the relevant DTC should be reported.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：故障注入测试 Fault Injection Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：

#### 4.1.2 Cryptographic Material
**REQ:AF26008201-278970-2687_Secure Certificate Storage**
- 编号：AF26008201-278970-2687
- 对象类型：需求
- 状态：草稿
- 需求类型：SysReq
- 标题：Secure Certificate Storage
- 所属章：AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification>4 Non-Functional Analysis>4.1 Information Security Requirements>4.1.2 Cryptographic Material
- 需求集：/01_产品系统/03_产品系统需求开发/AF260082_APCU_ProductSystemRequirementsSpecification(主干)
- 评审人：
- 父需求：AF26008201-276726-398_Security - Non-Volatile Memory for Certificates
- 依赖：
- 附件：
- 详述：

    The SCU shall provide non-volatile memory to the Standard Security Architecture to store the certificates and the corresponding private key, as defined in the following table.
    
    | Name | Size |
    |---|---:|
    | Root CA Certificate | 400 bytes |
    | Backend CA Certificate | 425 bytes |
    | ECU Certificate | 600 bytes |
    | ECU Private Key | 32 bytes |
- SysReqType：Function
- Requirement Status：Valid
- Sources：External
- Rationale：
- Allocation：SW
- ASIL Level：QM
- Cyber Security：Yes
- Release Stage：A Sample
- Impact on Environment：Stores security certificates and private key in non-volatile memory, enabling secure communication without affecting physical environment.
- Verification Method：测试Test
- Verification Criteria：Code design review to ensure the crytographic material is stored in a protected NVM which only can be accessed by Daimler security diagnostic.
- Legally relevant：NO
- Test Method：基于需求的测试 Req-Based Test,鲁棒性测试 Robustness Test
- Comment：
